jobs.title: Administrative and Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ADMINISTRATIVE and PROGRAM COORDINATOR**

**Organizational Description:** 

NICOS Chinese Health Coalition is a public\-private\-community partnership of more than 30 health and human service organizations and concerned individuals. The mission of NICOS is to enhance the health and well\-being of the San Francisco Chinese community. Since 1985, NICOS has been engaged in advocacy, research, training, coalition\-building and program implementation for the benefit of this population and the organizations that serve it.

**Position Summary:**

Under the supervision of the Executive Director, the Administrative and Program Coordinator is primarily responsible for overseeing the overall day\-to\-day smooth functioning of office and agency operations of a small nonprofit organization. The Administrative and Program Coordinator: provides administrative and clerical support; conducts payroll, benefits and human resource administration; performs bookkeeping functions; facilitates communication with board, staff and partners; runs errands; provides client support; assists with projects and programs, including support for healthcare enrollment and navigation services. This is a full\-time position, but may be adjusted to part\-time based on the candidate’s needs (30\-40 hrs/wk).

**Compensation:** $24 \- $27/ hr \+ benefits

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Oversee day\-to\-day smooth functioning of office and agency operations, including general administrative and clerical duties such as reception, communications, inventory management, equipment upkeep, facilities maintenance, errands
* Conduct human resource administration, including onboarding new employees, maintaining personnel files, ensuring compliance with agency policies, processing time\-off requests
* Conduct payroll administration, including calculation of wages and benefits and timely coordination with payroll service
* Perform daily financial and bookkeeping duties including A/P, A/R utilizing Quickbooks; ensure accurate billing of contractors and timely payment to vendors
* Develop and maintain administrative, operations and recordkeeping systems
* Respond to phone calls and emails; provide client support; organize, schedule meetings and appointments
* Assist with event planning and implementation, including support as needed for workshops, trainings, meetings, conferences/ teleconferences
* Coordinate agency communications; maintain databases, listservs
* Provide programmatic support, including healthcare enrollment and navigation services to agency clients as needed
* Assist in conducting community outreach and promotion as needed
* Compile minutes, reports, presentations, proposals, and other documents
* Contribute to the development of a team effort encouraging growth, professionalism, and active participation of all staff, interns and volunteers
* Perform other duties as requested by the Executive Director and/or other members of the NICOS Management Team

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Public Health or related fields preferred; year(s) of relevant work experience may be substituted for year(s) of equivalent education
* Experience with administrative/ office operations preferred, preferably in a nonprofit setting
* Knowledge of accounting, booking with QuickBooks strongly preferred
* Excellent organizational, analytical and interpersonal skills required
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills required
* Good time management skills and ability to multi\-task and prioritize work
* Proficiency with PC (Windows 11\) and computer environment/ software applications, including Word, Excel, Publisher required
* Bilingual English/Chinese (Cantonese preferred, Mandarin a plus) strongly preferred; biliterate and ability to typeset in Chinese desirable
* Ability to gain certification as a Covered California Certified Enrollment Counselor preferred
* Share in the values and mission of the organization
* Ability to support and implement the goals and objectives of NICOS and its projects
* Willingness to work nights and weekends as needed
* Have access to reliable transportation; willingness to travel within the San Francisco Bay Area

**Application:** 

Please send resume and cover letter, with subject heading: “Administrative and Program Coordinator Search” to kentwoo@nicoschc.org; or mail to: NICOS Chinese Health Coalition, 945 Clay Street, San Francisco, CA 94108; or fax to: 415\-788\-0966 (No calls or drop\-ins please).

Deadline: For Immediate Hire.

*This organization provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information or veteran status. In addition to federal law requirements, this organization complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. This organization expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information or veteran status*

Pay: $24\.00 \- $27\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

* Do you have Quickbooks experience?

Language:

* Cantonese (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

jobs.title: Senior Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Role Summary**


Are you an energetic, community\-minded professional passionate about empowering older adults to live vibrant, independent, and healthy lives? We are seeking an inspiring **Senior Center Program Coordinator** to help lead dynamic community\-based programming!


In this rewarding role, you will coordinate and support key center operations, educational workshops, wellness activities, and community outreach. Working as part of a collaborative team, you will manage workshop schedules, assist with patient enrollments, facilitate classes, and build strong relationships with community partners. If you thrive in a bustling, people\-first environment and want to make a positive impact every day, this opportunity offers a fulfilling path to support active seniors!

### **Duties \& Responsibilities**

#### **Program Facilitation \& Community Outreach**

* Coordinate and assist with core program operations, including patient enrollment, workshop facilitation, and daily activities.
* Manage schedules for classes and workshops while coordinating coverage across various program sites.
* Assist with outreach initiatives and referral programs, including conducting workshops and educational classes.
* Support language access by providing translation assistance for monolingual patients.
* Assist in coordinating partner meetings by gathering information, taking detailed notes, and managing follow\-ups.
* Review and maintain accurate patient information, operational documentation, records, and program reports.
* Conduct regular program assessments, site visits, and community surveys.
* Handle donation collections and maintain accurate financial reporting.
* Order, receive, and maintain central inventory and program supplies.
* Provide administrative support and coverage as Staff on Duty as needed.
* Ensure strict adherence to all operational procedures, contract specifications, and regulatory standards.
* Travel to other local service sites as needed within city limits.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education \& Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of professional work experience.

#### **Language \& Technical Capabilities**

* **Software Proficiency:** Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite and database management software.
* **Communication \& Independence:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to follow detailed instructions and work independently.
* **Physical Requirements:** Ability to stand for prolonged periods and occasionally lift up to 50 lbs.

### **Desired Qualifications**

* **Language Skills:** Required bilingual fluency in English/Spanish or English/Chinese.
* **Senior Engagement:** Minimum of one (1\) year of experience working directly with older adults or senior citizens.
* **Outreach Experience:** Minimum of one (1\) year of experience and comfort engaging in community outreach efforts.
* **Specialized Certifications:** Certification as a Diabetes Educator or Health Educator is a plus.

### **Location and Work Type**

* **Work Type:** Full\-Time Position.
* **Work Setting:** On\-Site Senior Center Environment (with local travel required to other service sites as needed).
* **Schedule:** Standard daytime hours, Monday through Friday.

**If you're interested, please reply to this advertisement or directly email your resume to me at DSalgado@teemagroup.com or by calling/texting (949\) 295\-5951\.**  

**I strive to reply within 48 hours. Looking forward to connecting with you soon. Thank you!**


\#Workwolf

jobs.description:
**SR. ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT \& PROGRAM** **COORDINATOR**

**Career Development Office**

**Classification:** Class Code 1635 / Level 1 / Non\-Exempt / Full\-Time / Benefited / Represented

**Hiring Salary Range:** $28\.50 \- $30\.00 / hour


**THE ROLE and RESPONSIBILITIES**


Under the general supervision of the Senior Assistant Dean, Career Development Office, the (Senior) Administrative Assistant is the frontline professional providing administrative and technical support to students and alumni for their career and professional development. This position is the first point of contact for the Career Development Office. The person in this position will work with all members of the Career Development Office staff responsible for or supporting programming, communications, and resources. A substantive part of this position is event organization and support. This position will have regular meetings with the Assistant Dean for the Career Development Office, under whose department it is directly housed, and will be involved in other Career Office efforts and programming. Whether this position is designated as Senior will depend on the level of experience.


Typical duties and responsibilities consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

* Functions as the main reception for the office, fielding questions, scheduling appointments, taking calls, and conducting student, alumni, and employer outreach.
* Coordinates a career fair for multiple law schools. Responsibilities include employer and student outreach and registration, administration of the scheduling, networking, and interviewing software, responding to questions, coordinating volunteers, developing the resources and instructions, and troubleshooting any issues.
* Serves as focal point for disseminating information to students, alumni and employers pertaining to office resources, job postings, programs, dates, and deadlines.
* Acts as administrative support for office staff of approximately 10 people, including processing all invoices and purchase orders and assisting the Assistant Dean with managing department budget and expenses, as well as inventorying and coordinating office supplies and the office library of resources and managing departmental publications and video library of events.
* Maintains, manages, and troubleshoots online platforms including appointment scheduling system, room reservations software, online job board, and assists with other data entry projects, including tracking of job listings.
* Provides event support, including scheduling and coordinating events and room reservations for event calendar, and designing and disseminating promotional materials and signage for events, and data entry and tracking regarding all office\-sponsored events.
* Liaises with other campus departments to facilitate event coordination and project\-planning.
* Manages and processes day\-to\-day administration of fellowship including coordinating with Fiscal and HR, managing a large cohort of fellowship recipients, tracking their hours and placement information, collecting, and analyzing timesheets, processing payment requests, coordinating the separation process at end of each fellowship, and answering questions regarding the program.
* Performs other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.


**REQUIREMENTS**


**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**


The following education and experiences are required:

* Bachelor's degree or the equivalent of 4 years of combined education and work experience at an institution of higher education
* Event and project management experience essential, particularly planning and organizing logistics for events of all sizes
* Experience, comfort, and ability to learn new technologies and software including databases, and social media sites.


It is preferable but not required if applicants have the additional experience:

* Front office administrative support work experience involving extensive public contact, ideally in a campus setting.
* Experience in an academic or law\-related environment.
* Experience with recruiting software (e.g., Symplicity, 12Twenty, Flo Recruit), online appointment scheduling software, basic graphic design skills, and basic video editing.
* Must be enthusiastic about working with a diverse student population.


**DESIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES**

* Demonstrated organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills.
* Project management skills.
* Ability to organize and process large amounts of data and independently follow detailed, step\-by\-step instructions.
* Detail\-oriented and precise with excellent organization skills and ability to thrive in a fast paced, very public environment.
* Strong multi\-tasking skills and ability to meet changing priorities, regular deadlines and handle frequent interruptions.
* Computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, graphics software, database software, internet search techniques, basic HTML (plus), basic video editing.


**BENEFITS**


**Health and Welfare Benefits**


* Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance coverage
* Flexible Spending Accounts for transportation\-related, healthcare and dependent care expenses

**For your Financial Future**

**For your Work/Life Balance**

jobs.description:
**POSITION**  

People Operations Compliance Coordinator


**OUR MISSION**  

To empower the youth in our community with equitable access to social, academic, and career opportunities to thrive


**OUR VISION**  

All youth grow up to lead fulfilling lives fueled by their passions, talents, and a love of learning


**OUR CORE VALUES**  

Curiosity, Respect, Ownership, Ganas, Unity, Equity


**ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW**  

Boys \& Girls Clubs of the Peninsula (BGCP) proudly stands as the largest expanded learning provider in San Mateo County, dedicated to empowering 7,000 TK\-College students across 31 sites from East Palo Alto to Daly City. We believe that talent is equally distributed across Silicon Valley, but opportunity is not, so we are committed to ensuring that socio\-economically disadvantaged students have equitable access to the opportunities that will help them thrive in school and beyond. Students benefit from high\-quality academic programs, captivating enrichment activities, and access to critical mental health services. With support from our staff, Board, and broader Team BGCP community, we strive to make our community a great place for all kids to grow up.


**POSITION OVERVIEW**



The People Operations Compliance Coordinator supports BGCP's compliance, recordkeeping, and data integrity efforts across employee and volunteer programs. This role coordinates compliance processes, maintains accurate and audit\-ready records, and helps ensure adherence to organizational policies, regulatory requirements, and BGCA standards.



Reporting to the Senior Director of People Operations, with a dotted\-line partnership to the Senior Director of Community Engagement, this role partners closely with the People Operations Generalist, broader People Team, and Volunteer Team to support compliance administration, policy implementation, audit readiness, and HRIS data integrity. Success in this role requires strong organization, attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple compliance\-related processes in a dynamic environment.

* Maintain compliance with California law, BGCA standards, and organizational policies; monitor updates and recommend enhancements
* Support internal, external, and regulatory audits by ensuring documentation is complete, accurate, and readily accessible
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of HRIS and related systems through regular audits, updates, and documentation
* Maintain employee records, including status, roles, and organizational data, with a high level of confidentiality
* Maintain personnel files in accordance with organizational policy and record retention requirements
* Manage policy lifecycle processes, including handbook updates, distribution, and acknowledgment tracking
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes by ensuring required documentation and system updates are completed and audit\-ready

### **Volunteer Compliance \& Oversight**


* Maintain accurate tracking systems and records for volunteer and external partner compliance requirements including background checks, TB documentation, and required trainings
* Maintain compliance with California law, BGCA standards, and BGCP policies by monitoring regulatory updates, conducting regular audits, and recommending and implementing process improvements to ensure ongoing adherence
* Conduct regular audits of volunteer documentation and compliance status in partnership with the Volunteer Team
* Develop resources and visual guides to strengthen understanding of compliance requirements
* Support facilitation of volunteer compliance training and orientation sessions, both in\-person and virtual
* Respond to compliance\-related inquiries from volunteers, staff, and external partners
* Support the creation, maintenance, and refinement of reports, dashboards, and analyses that inform internal communication and data\-driven decision\-making


**Reporting \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Produce and maintain compliance, audit, and workforce reports; track trends and identify improvement opportunities
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to codify processes and ensure alignment with compliance requirements
* Collaborate across People Team to ensure consistency in processes and systems
* Provide guidance on compliance\-related processes and identify opportunities to improve workflows, systems, and operational efficiency

jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 8 years of experience in strategic operations, program management, high\-growth technology, infrastructure development, or real estate investment.
* Experience designing and running organizational rhythms, including OKR/KPI setting, Annual Operating Plans, and Quarterly Business Reviews.
* Working familiarity with commercial real estate agreement structures, land acquisition, colocation leasing, zoning, environmental reviews, and utility timelines.
* Strong analytical background in maintaining auditable agreement databases (e.g., Salesforce, GIS) to empower leadership with actionable business intelligence.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments by eliminating multi\-stakeholder bottlenecks and establishing standard operating procedures.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a key strategic partner within Data Center Investments and Development (DCID), you will work directly with leadership and strategic negotiators to deliver data center compute capacity. Operating at the critical intersection of strategy, communications, and business operations, you will assist the organization’s operating cadence, including OKRs, quarterly business reviews, yearly budgeting, and executive communications. You will partner closely with leadership and organizational stakeholders to establish standard operating procedures, govern data integrity, and accelerate agreement velocity by designing frictionless approval workflows. Additionally, you will advocate operational transformation by deploying scalable AI, and represent DCID across technical, financial, and real estate teams, as you ensure seamless cross\-functional alignment, elevate data\-driven decision\-making, foster continuous organizational learning across the data center delivery lifecycle and ensure strategic priorities are translated into scalable operational frameworks.


The Development Pipeline and Business Operation (DPBO) team supports land acquisitions and data center leasing through data integrity oversight, development of standard operating procedures, policies and best practices, and deployment of AI tools aimed at streamlining the agreement flow. Members of the team contribute at each milestone, from site selection/intake/origination, through approvals, on to asset management. As markets shift, and business needs evolve, DPBO is at the frontline, adjusting course so the greater Data Center Investments and Development (DCID) team can respond.


DPBO also serves as the connective tissue between DCID and cross\-functional teams, coordinating collaboration and translating priorities. This gives DPBO a birds\-eye view of the entire data center life\-cycle, allowing team members to develop high\-leverage expertise across acquisitions, contracting, technology and business operations.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Act as a team multiplier by managing ambiguity, eliminating organizational friction, identifying agreement\-flow bottlenecks, and ensuring strategic priorities are systematically executed.
* Craft organization\-wide communications, bridge gaps between functional silos, manage change\-management initiatives, and plan learning opportunities.
* Develop standard operating procedures and serve as the point person for organization\-wide directives, including OKRs, yearly budgets, and quarterly business reviews.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams to deploy scalable AI that transforms operational efficiency while building tools that promote data integrity.
* Serve as the connective tissue between DCID and cross\-functional teams by coordinating collaboration and translating priorities.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. jobs.description:
**Site Operations Manager – Sports \& Entertainment Venue**


**Location: Northern California**  

**Salary: $120,000 annually**


**Lead the Janitorial Operations for a Professional Sports and Entertainment Venue**



Pritchard Sports \& Entertainment Group is seeking an accomplished **Site Operations Manager** to lead janitorial and housekeeping operations for a high\-profile sports and entertainment venue in Northern California.



Reporting to the District Manager, this position is responsible for the overall performance of a complex, high\-volume operation supporting games, concerts, special events, and daily facility needs. The Site Operations Manager will lead a diverse unionized workforce that may include managers, supervisors, leads, full\-time and part\-time team members, event and post\-event staff, and approved contract labor.



The successful candidate will be a visible, hands\-on leader with extensive experience managing large venue operations, building strong client relationships, developing high\-performing teams, and delivering exceptional service in a fast\-paced environment.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Venue and Event Operations**


* Plan, coordinate, and oversee all aspects of daily housekeeping, event cleaning, and post\-event cleaning operations.
* Develop comprehensive staffing and deployment plans based on event schedules, attendance projections, venue configurations, and client requirements.
* Inspect arena seating, suites, concourses, restrooms, premium areas, offices, back\-of\-house spaces, and other assigned areas to ensure operational readiness and service quality.
* Ensure cleaning services are coordinated and executed safely, efficiently, professionally, and in accordance with contractual expectations.
* Respond to client concerns with urgency, professionalism, and effective follow\-through.
* Remain accessible and highly visible during major events, operational transitions, and other critical service periods.

  


**Client and Stakeholder Partnership**


* Serve as the primary liaison between Pritchard Sports \& Entertainment Group and the venue’s management team.
* Build trusted relationships with client leaders, venue partners, third\-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* Participate in operational meetings, event\-planning meetings, post\-event reviews, and other internal or external meetings as needed.
* Provide timely updates regarding staffing, service delivery, safety, quality, and operational risks.
* Oversee approved subcontractors and third\-party service providers to ensure performance aligns with contractual and operational standards.


**Labor Relations and Union Workforce Management**


* Lead daily operations within a unionized work environment while maintaining productive, professional relationships with union representatives, shop stewards, employees, and venue leadership.
* Apply and administer collective bargaining agreements consistently, including provisions related to scheduling, seniority, job assignments, overtime, attendance, employee classifications, work rules, and disciplinary procedures.
* Partner closely with Human Resources and Labor Relations when addressing grievances, investigations, corrective actions, employee concerns, and contract\-interpretation matters.
* Maintain accurate documentation and ensure management decisions comply with collective bargaining agreements, company policies, and applicable labor laws.
* Train and coach managers and supervisors on effective union workforce management and consistent application of contract requirements.
* Support labor\-management meetings, grievance resolution, contract implementation, and collective bargaining preparations as needed.
* Anticipate labor\-related operational risks and develop practical solutions that protect service continuity, employee relations, and client satisfaction.


**Required Union Labor Experience**


* Substantial, hands\-on experience managing a large, unionized workforce in a complex, high\-volume operation is required.
* Demonstrated knowledge of collective bargaining agreements, grievance procedures, progressive discipline, seniority provisions, scheduling requirements, overtime rules, and union work practices.
* Proven ability to build effective working relationships with union representatives and shop stewards while maintaining management accountability and operational standards.
* Experience working in partnership with Human Resources, Labor Relations, and legal counsel on sensitive employee and labor matters.
* Union workforce experience within a major arena, stadium, convention center, entertainment venue, hospitality operation, or large\-scale janitorial environment is strongly preferred.


**Team Leadership**


* Lead, coach, and develop managers, supervisors, leads, and frontline team members.
* Plan schedules and assign work for full\-time, part\-time, event, and post\-event employees.
* Partner with Human Resources and Talent Acquisition on workforce planning, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and corrective action.
* Establish clear performance expectations and hold leaders accountable for service quality, productivity, attendance, safety, and employee engagement.
* Develop and conduct operational, equipment, service, and safety training programs.
* Foster a respectful, inclusive, and service\-focused workplace culture.


**Financial and Administrative Management**


* Develop, manage, and monitor the site’s operating budget, labor expenses, supplies, equipment, and other controllable costs.
* Maintain appropriate financial procedures, records, accounts, and internal controls.
* Track the cost of work performed and prepare cost estimates, labor reports, and event settlements as requested.
* Review payroll and labor reports for accuracy and timely submission.
* Maintain required logs, inspection reports, safety reports, staffing records, and other operational documentation.

**Real Estate Project Manager**

**Location:** Sunnyvale / Santa Clara County, CA — Hybrid Preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Compensation:** $85,000–$100,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications

**About The Shee Group**

The Shee Group is a residential real estate team serving Silicon Valley and surrounding communities. We are committed to providing exceptional service, strong communication, and a seamless experience for our clients throughout the buying and selling process.

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and owner\-minded **Real Estate Project Manager** to oversee listing preparation, transaction support, client communication, vendor coordination, and day\-to\-day operational projects.

**Position Overview**

The Real Estate Project Manager serves as a central point of coordination between clients, agents, vendors, transaction coordinators, and internal team members. This person is responsible for taking ownership of projects from start to finish and ensuring that listings, transactions, and operational priorities move forward smoothly, efficiently, and on schedule.

This role requires someone who can work **independently with minimal supervision**. The successful candidate will be expected to identify what needs to happen next, anticipate potential issues, develop solutions, and take appropriate action without waiting for step\-by\-step direction.

The ideal candidate has strong judgment, thinks several steps ahead, follows through consistently, and knows when to make decisions independently and when leadership approval is necessary.

jobs.description:
**What We're Looking For**


At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee\-owners.
  

  

This opportunity entails being responsible managing assigned project(s) throughout their full lifecycle including developing the scope and technical sections of proposal and procurement documents to participating in contract negotiations and overseeing the delivery of the project plan to successfully accomplish HNTB’s 4 for 4 performance: delivery of quality work, on time, on budget and to the client’s satisfaction on every project. This position proactively manages the budget, schedule, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and client communications in support of the project’s objectives. Provides high level technical tasks while managing and reviewing design related specifications, calculations, reports and plans. Coordinates with internal and external partners including cross\-discipline and functional teams to address and problem solve design related issues or concerns. The Project Manager II – Engineering typically manages multi\-disciplinary project team(s) for one or more strategic (\<$1M) or mini\-mega ($1M to \<$5M) projects, or may lead and/or work as a discipline lead on a mega ($5M to \< $25M) project management team.**What You'll Do:**

* Responsible for development of the project scope and fee quotation and assists in the preparation of technical proposals and contracts in accordance with HNTB's Sophisticated Contracting Approach (SCA). Leads or actively participates in client contract scoping and negotiations.
* Serves as the primary client liaison and manages the project team to deliver the scope, schedule and budgets to completion and to the client’s satisfaction. Leads client contract scoping and negotiations.
* Performs technical discipline tasks including analysis, reports, design, specification, and production for assigned projects.
* Implements the firm’s project delivery plan using HNTB's Sophisticated Delivery Approach (SDA) on each project. Leads the development and the execution of the project management plan. Supervises and mentors team to overall project objectives.
* Responsible for/oversees project staffing, including, but not limited to; recruitment, development, retention, and succession of project staff; development of plan for project staff reporting; and support for performance and compensation reviews.
* Partners with Client Service Leaders and pursuit champions to assist with business development, building client relationships, and pursuit efforts for mini\-mega and mega projects in accordance with HNTB's Sophisticated Sales Approach (SSA). Works with the project team and marketing resources to prepare appropriate proposal and presentation materials. Leads proposal development and interview presentations for strategic, mini\-mega, and mega projects to the client as well as general presentations within the industry and community.
* May be responsible for the recruitment, hiring, development and retention of staff, including development of plan for staff reporting, performance and compensation reviews, and succession.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**What You'll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and 10 years of relevant experience
* 2 years of successful management of engineering projects

**What You'll Bring:**

* Winning, contracting, and successfully delivering 4for4 (on\-time, on\-budget, quality, client satisfaction) on multi\-disciplined projects. Identifying and handling risk and change management with guidance from more experienced staff.
* Leading a team on mid\-sized and/or moderately complex projects inside and outside of HNTB using sub\-consultants.
* Using system tools to manage, monitor, and deliver mid\-sized and/or moderately complex projects.
* Leading with minimal assistance from the Office Management Team in implementing HNTB Sophisticated processes as applicable to the project.
* Serving as the lead interface with the client on moderately complex projects.
* Developing successors to work with same client on other work.

**What We Prefer:**

* Master’s degree in Engineering
* 12 years relevant experience
* Professional Engineer (PE) certification
* American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) certification
* Project Management Professional (PMP)

Best Brother Builder is a fast\-growing residential construction company serving the San Francisco Bay Area. We specialize in custom homes, home additions, ADUs, major remodels, and residential development projects.

Our mission is to deliver exceptional craftsmanship, efficient project management, and outstanding customer service. We believe our employees are our greatest asset and are committed to providing a supportive environment where individuals can learn, grow, and build long\-term careers.

Working directly with experienced Project Managers, you will gain hands\-on experience throughout every stage of construction—from project startup to final inspection.

This position is ideal for someone seeking a long\-term career in construction management, with a clear path to becoming a Project Manager.

\* Coordinate project startup activities

\* Call 811 before excavation

\* Schedule portable toilets, temporary fencing, dumpsters, and underground utility locating

\* Coordinate inspections with local building departments

\* Coordinate PG\&E and other utility\-related work

\* Review construction drawings and project documents

\* Verify field measurements and construction details

\* Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, surveyors, soil engineers, solar contractors, fire sprinkler contractors, sewer contractors, and other consultants

\* Track project schedules and subcontractor progress

\* Assist with material purchasing and budget tracking

\* Maintain project documentation and project records

\* Support quality control inspections and follow\-up items

\* Help ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and according to company quality standards

⸻

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

\* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Design, or a related field

\* Excellent organizational and time management skills

\* Strong verbal and written communication skills

\* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities

\* Strong attention to detail

\* Positive attitude and willingness to learn

\* Valid California Driver’s License and reliable transportation

\* Willingness to travel to project sites throughout the Bay Area

Preferred Qualifications

\* Previous experience in residential construction, engineering, architecture, or project coordination

\* Ability to read construction drawings

\* Experience with Microsoft Office, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, Buildertrend, or similar construction management software

\* Knowledge of California residential permitting and construction processes

\* Ability to communicate professionally in both English and Mandarin Chinese. Mandarin is preferred because this position frequently communicates with Mandarin\-speaking clients, subcontractors, and vendors.

⸻

Compensation

$20\.00–$35\.00 per hour \+ Performance Bonus

Paid Training

Entry\-level candidates begin with a paid training period at $18\.70/hour.

Following successful completion of training, compensation is reviewed based on performance.

Typical compensation progression:

\* $20\.00/hour after successful completion of training

\* Approximately $25\.00/hour after 6 months

\* Approximately $30\.00/hour \+ Project Bonus after 1 year

\* Approximately $35\.00/hour \+ Project Bonus after 2 years

Performance reviews are conducted regularly. Compensation increases are based on individual performance, responsibility, and overall contribution.

⸻

Benefits

\* Performance\-Based Bonus

\* Paid Training

\* Career Development Opportunities

\* Paid Sick Leave (6 days annually)

\* Paid Vacation (5 days annually)

\* Opportunity for Advancement to Project Manager

\* H\-1B Sponsorship Available for Qualified Candidates

⸻

Work Schedule

\* Full\-time

\* Monday–Saturday

\* 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

\* Sundays and Major Holidays Off

⸻

Why Join Best Brother Builder?

At Best Brother Builder, you won’t just have a job—you’ll build a career.

We invest in our employees by providing hands\-on training, mentorship, and opportunities to advance into leadership roles. You’ll work on exciting custom home and residential development projects throughout the Bay Area while developing valuable technical and project management skills.

If you’re looking for a company where hard work is recognized, growth is encouraged, and your career has a clear future, we’d love to meet you.

* Paid time off

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience with supply or demand planning (e.g., demand forecasting, inventory management, resource allocation, etc.).
* Experience working with data analytics tools and reporting platforms.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with supply/demand planning, material planning, data center infrastructure, or capital investment decision making.
* Experience in managing technical programs with hardware teams.
* Ability to take accountability and ownership for end\-to\-end project lifecycle.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As part of the Network Planning team, you will be responsible for enabling various data center networking deployments by working with cross functional teams to develop end to end strategies that connect our demand, supply, inventory, data center labor and deployment planning. Your role will directly enable improving effectiveness of network planning team and overall network domain.  

  

This role requires an individual to leverage strategic and end to end thinking. Successful individuals in this role have strong planning backgrounds with an engineering mindset, while being expert communicators and leaders. They are comfortable with ambiguity and complexity, yet strive to increase maturity in processes. They also have the ability to handle multiple programs at the same time while being highly customer focused.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

--------------------

* Identify changes introduced by large scale business initiatives, drive business requirements and lead development/implementation with engineering teams to successfully land the programs.
* Partner with cross functional teams in deployments, supply chain planning, operations and engineering to identify, develop and lead large scale programs that improve our deployment velocity, inventory efficiency and supply resiliency.

* Define continuous improvement areas based upon metrics and work with engineering/systems team to establish program roadmaps to deliver the improvements.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Employee Experience M&A
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
  
  

Adobe's Employee Experience (EX) M\&A team owns the people\-related dimensions of every transaction—from due diligence through close and post\-close integration. As deal volume and complexity have grown, we are adding a Senior Program Manager to bring dedicated capacity to the integration workstreams that most directly shape the acquired\-employee experience: change management, culture integration, onboarding, and leadership/manager/team enablement.
  
  

Working alongside our existing program leads, you will run defined workstreams end\-to\-end—designing the plan, coordinating cross\-functionally, and driving execution against timeline and quality bars—while building the mechanics and playbooks that let the team scale.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Design and lead deal\-specific EX change management strategies, including onboarding (leadership onboarding through team onboarding), post\-onboarding monitoring, and retrospectives.
  
Assess cultural gaps between Adobe and target companies, and build practical bridging programs that ease the transition for acquired employees and leaders.
  
Facilitate onboarding and enablement activities; guide managers and leaders through periods of significant organizational change.
  
Design and act on employee pulse surveys during organizational change, translating signals into interventions.
  
Partner with target\-company and Adobe leaders to align integration plans, and connect structural design (org and operating model) to the lived employee experience (culture, onboarding, enablement).
  
Align EX change and culture initiatives with the broader communications strategy so messaging and action reinforce each other.
  
Coordinate across Corporate Development / Integration, Legal, Finance, ATS/Systems, HRBPs, and business leaders to keep EX integration workstreams on track.
  
Independently manage workstream mechanics \- timelines, tracking, documentation and and prepare clear, executive\-level status reporting.
  
Develop and track integration metrics and pulse\-survey signals to measure EX effectiveness and inform leadership decision\-making.
  
Build a network of external standards and industry benchmarks to continuously refine EX M\&A playbooks.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
  

Required
  
7\+ years in HR, with M\&A experience focused on integration, change management, or culture work; exposure across all deal phases is ideal.
  
Hands\-on experience designing and delivering change\-management or culture\-integration programs in a deal context.
  
Strong data proficiency, including comfort working with employee census and workforce data and HRIS systems (e.g., Workday) to identify trends, flag risks, and inform integration decisions.
  
Experience designing onboarding programs and delivering leadership onboarding post\-close.
  
Experience designing and acting on employee pulse surveys during periods of organizational change.
  
Strong facilitation skills—comfortable leading workshops and driving alignment in rapidly changing, ambiguous environments.
  
Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver clear, well\-structured, and impactful executive level presentations that distill complex integration work into insights for senior leadership.
  
Skilled at partnering with communications and cross\-functional teams to align messaging and action.
  
Strong program management fundamentals; able to independently own workstream mechanics (timelines, tracking, documentation) across concurrent priorities.
  
Ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in handling highly confidential, deal\-related information
  
  

Preferred
  
Consulting experience (management, HR, or M\&A advisory), bringing a fungible, deploy\-anywhere skills the team can apply across transformation work.
  
Proven ability to thrive in a high\-volume, high\-pressure environment with competing priorities across multiple time zones and geographies, maintaining quality and composure under tight deal timelines.
  
Experience with complex\-structured, stock, or asset deals.
  
Experience coaching managers and leaders through significant organizational change.
  
Breadth to operate as a utility player—able to move across M\&A and broader transformation initiatives as priorities shift.
  
Willingness and ability to travel on short notice to support critical deal moments throughout the transaction lifecycle, from diligence through integration, as deals require.
  
  

About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
  
  

Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager Services, Finance Transformation
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish.  

  

Do you love thinking analytically? Are you passionate about using your financial knowledge to navigate complex challenges? Just as our customers find value in Apple products, the Finance group finds value for both Apple and its shareholders. As part of this group, you'll play an integral role in ensuring our day\-to\-day financial health. You and your team will support Apple's growth, both top and bottom line, by applying the same level of innovation toward financial matters as we do toward our products and services. You'll also collaborate with Apple teams across the world to develop more effective investment strategies and risk management. Finance is essential to upholding our global commitment to perfection, and it is directly responsible for shaping the company's future. Join us, and you'll have an important role in continuing Apple's legacy of efficiency and success.  

  

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong Program Manager to drive Services Finance transformation initiatives, modernizing and optimizing the systems, workflows, and controls that power Apple's ecosystem, including Ads, App Store, Maps, Music, TV, and WPC. This role works hand\-in\-hand with Services Finance, IS\&T, Services Engineering, and SME’s within the broader finance organization. The ideal candidate is a naturally technical operator, and a classic document\-driven program manager, who can organize engineering work into coherent, deliverable capabilities.  

  

**Description**  

  

The Senior Program Manager will develop and articulate a clear vision and roadmap for transforming Services Finance processes, systems, and workflows. This role is grounded first in Services domain expertise, executed through hands\-on technical program management, and enabled by direct fluency in data and systems.  

  

","responsibilities":"Own the program plan, timeline, and cross\-functional coordination for transformation initiatives, in close collaboration with Finance, Services, and IS\&T leadership.  

  

Collaborate with Services Business teams, Finance, and IS\&T to design next\-generation financial systems that support ongoing business evolution.  

  

Develop a programmatic strategy for Apple’s financial system architecture to facilitate business expansion through robust financial accounting automation, internal controls, and strategic alignment.  

  

Evaluate, recommend, and oversee implementation of new enterprise technologies and systems using direct technical fluency to validate solutions in close partnership with IS\&T.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Advanced knowledge of subscription finance ecosystems, including billing, revenue recognition, and financial reporting across various service business models  

  

Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex and technical cross\-functional projects, influence stakeholders, and drive change across IS\&T, PMO, and business units  

  

General knowledge of core GBS processes (Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report)  

  

Hands\-on experience with systems supporting subscription and services finance, including defining initial requirements and developing system designs.  

  

Proven ability to apply emerging technologies (Generative AI, RPA) to Services Finance problems such as revenue recognition anomaly detection, subscription billing reconciliation, and automated compliance monitoring, from concept through implementation.  

  

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance and internal\-controls frameworks relevant to service subscriptions and finance operations.  

  

Demonstrated expertise in the architectural design and implementation of Financial Systems and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions.  

  

Experience distilling complex technical work and system architecture designs into clear, business\-relevant presentations for senior management and executive audiences.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

7\-10 years of progressive experience in program management, finance operations, systems analysis, or process transformation, with demonstrated success owning significant technical workstreams end\-to\-end.  

  

BS or BA in Business, Economics, or equivalent.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $207,400 and $311,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

Please submit your resume and a short cover letter explaining why you're a good fit for managing HR in a trades\-focused environment to kayla.omalley@ethosei.com. Apply today with your updated resume, and let's get started!

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Temporary

The **Operations Coordinator** plays a vital role in supporting maintenance operations. This position ensures the seamless coordination of maintenance requests, vendor scheduling, and project support. Working closely with the General Operations Managers and Maintenance Supervisors, the Operations Coordinator prioritizes service requests and maintains compliance with maintenance standards. By streamlining processes and ensuring timely communication with residents and vendors, this role is essential to keeping a portfolio of properties running efficiently and effectively. Work is primarily conducted in person in an assigned Essex office to communicate with residents, vendors, and fellow associates in person, relying on virtual and telecommunication when that is not possible. On occasion, in\-person meetings, project management, and inspections needed on\-site at properties within the portfolio.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

* Manage and prioritize service requests using SightPlan.
* Schedule pre\-move\-out and final move\-out inspections with residents, which may be conducted in person or virtually as needs demand.
* Create purchase orders for vendor services and track vendor\-related work orders.
* Schedule vendors for unit turnovers based on inspection findings.
* Monitor unit turnover and maintenance work orders to ensure timely completion.
* Respond to onsite emergencies and coordinate with the onsite team, including providing in\-person support and coverage as needed for colleagues at other locations.
* Partner with CMS Project Manager in supporting various asset improvement and preventative maintenance projects. Be the Community Management stakeholder of each project.
* Assist in scheduling and granting property access for projects led by Project Execution and sustainability, which can require onsite presence to facilitate.
* Communicate with on\-site team and residents in person (or telephonically and virtually when not possible) to confirm work completion, gather feedback, and recommend improvements.
* Assist in purchasing supplies, equipment, and services while tracking budget variances and escalating concerns as needed.
* Other responsibilities as deemed necessary by the company as part of the ordinary course of business.

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required. College degree preferred.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with property management or CRM software.
* Prior experience in customer service or property management is preferred.
* Commitment to providing exceptional customer service and a desire to help people.
* Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple responsibilities effectively.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a centralized hub environment.
* Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.
* Capability to utilize a personal smart device for apps related to property operations and communication.
* Ability to work onsite to complete essential job functions outlined above and as arise in the ordinary course of the job.

**WHAT THE JOB REQUIRES:**

* Maintain alignment with Essex policies and procedures while effectively managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain compliance with all applicable laws, e.g., Fair Housing, Landlord Tenant, Local Building Codes, OSHA, and EEOC.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to create, compose, and edit written materials.
* Regular, consistent, and timely attendance required.
* This role requires a five\-day workweek that will likely include weekend coverage. Work is primarily performed at an Essex office location, involving extended periods of sitting at a desk or workstation, with the regular need to deliver resident notices. This may involve walking and use of stairs for prolonged periods of time.
* Travel required for occasional meetings and training.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* Decisions made with thorough understanding of procedures, company policies, and business practices to achieve general results and deadlines.
* Team\-oriented mindset with a commitment to efficiency and service excellence.
* Initiative to enhance workflows and optimize maintenance processes.
* Detail\-focused approach to tracking and managing vendor relationships.
* Strong communication skills to foster positive resident experiences.
* Ability to exercise initiative.
* Ability to meet all job requirements and assignments.

### **\#LI\-Onsite**


All full\-time regular associates are offered competitive salaries, experience career growth, and are eligible for benefit packages that include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, 401k employer match, excellence rewards, wellness programs, and much more. With our 12 paid holidays and 15 PTO days, work/life balance is a priority! Additionally, most positions are eligible for a housing discount of 20%.
Essex provides great communities in which to live, work and invest. We are a purpose\-driven company, and we pride ourselves on promoting an internal culture of growth and opportunity by engaging, enabling, and empowering our teams. Working at Essex is not a destination. It is a journey where you can confidently build your career.


New hires generally start between $26\.92 \- $31\.25 per hour. The final salary offer will be determined after reviewing relevant factors, including but not limited to skill sets; relevant experience; internal equity; and other business and organizational needs.
This role is also eligible to participate in Essex’s discretionary Annual Bonus program that is commensurate with the level of the position.

jobs.title: Housing Case Manager – Rising Up
jobs.description:
3rd Street Youth Center \& Clinic is a community\-based agency providing youth in the Bayview Hunters Point with medical and behavioral health services that encourage them to make decisions that support their health, safety and development. The Housing Case Manager will provide comprehensive case management to TAY youth placed into housing via San Francisco's Rising Up initiative.

  

Rising Up is a public/private partnership launched by Mayor London Breed in support of the broader city\-wide goal of reducing homelessness for youth ages 18\-25 by 50% by 2023, ultimately assuring that homelessness for young people is rare, brief, and one\-time.

  

The Housing Case Manager will provide comprehensive case management to TAY youth placed into housing via San Francisco's Rising Up initiative.

 **Duties \& Responsibilities:**

  

The following is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the Housing Case Manager. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned as needed.

* Individual case management \& oversight to TAY referred from the Coordinated Entry System, including twice monthly home visits.
* Resource brokerage and referral as needed

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician
jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------



With direction from the QA Inspection Supervisor(s) and Quality Management perform dimensional inspections on machined and molded components manufactured from internal and external sources per engineering drawings and applicable external standards. Maintains inspection equipment including Vertex and Vectors. Also maintains control of products on hold.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------



Perform first article and final product inspections working from engineering drawings, procedures, and external standards, using typical inspection equipment such as micrometers, thread gauges, calipers, optical comparator, concentricity gauge, and height \& depth gages.


Perform receiving inspection of Finished Goods and components using typical inspection equipment.


Perform component testing utilizing various inspection equipment such as tensile testers, force gages and custom equipment.


Complete and maintain all QA paperwork in accordance with established procedures and manufacturing practices including the generation of receiving and inspection records, first article reports, discrepant material reports, QA history log sheets, and document change requests (DCR’s) as required. Ensure all handwritten documentation is clear and legible.


Support the qualification/validation of new products/process projects; perform specialized inspections to help engineering develop new products, gages, and inspection methods.


Follow written procedures and engineering specifications utilized for inspection and ensure documents are kept current and adequate for the inspections performed. Provide feedback to QA Management on documents requiring updates or error correction.


Interact with personnel from departments outside of the Quality Inspection department, i.e. Manufacturing, Materials, Engineering, etc, to improve on overall Quality of product entering into the QA Inspection department.


Generate Non\-conformance Reports for submitted product found out of specification. Coordinates movement/control/disposition of products that are under investigation for non\- conformance. Coordinate shipment of Finished Goods scrap for destruction. Generate Quality Hold documents and coordinate containment of affected product.


Publish various daily quality related reports.


Perform additional duties as assigned by supervisor.


Using typical MS Office software (Word, Excel, and Outlook) create and perform simple data entry tasks and procedure changes as requested by QA Management.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------



Ability to use typical measuring devices (micrometer, caliper, comparator, thread gages, go/nogo gages and custom gages) and test instruments (pull and torque testers).


Experience in medical device manufacturing and / or clean room is a plus.


Working knowledge of sampling techniques (e.g., ANSI Z1\.4\.), Good Manufacturing Practices and other regulatory standards required.


Ability to read standard operating procedures engineering drawings; Ability to lift boxes less than 50 lbs


Attention to detail


Ability to work independently


Good organizational and communication skills

**Your Background**
-------------------



High school Diploma or GED required.


Minimum of 5 years applicable experience required.


Work experience in an ISO and/or regulated industry environment preferred

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------


**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------



None

  

EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability
