jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician 1
jobs.description:
**Forming Our Future together**


FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de\-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.


Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership \& Accountability, Respectfully \& Effectively Communicate, and Motivate \& Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

**Shift:**


The regular hours for this position are Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and every other Saturday from 6:00pm to 6:15am. You will receive a 15% shift differential for working on the night shift.**Job Description:**


The **Quality Assurance Technician 1** is responsible for performing detailed inspections and quality control activities to ensure products meet internal standards and customer specifications. This role requires strong technical inspection skills, proficiency with microscopes and measurement tools, and the ability to collaborate with engineering and operations teams. The Technician will support both in‑process and final inspection workflows in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Inspection \& Quality Control**

* Perform detailed defect inspections of advanced probing technology products using the **Olympus MX‑50 microscope** and other precision inspection tools.
* Conduct **in‑process inspections** to verify product quality during various manufacturing stages.
* Complete **finished goods inspections** to ensure all outgoing material meets customer and internal specifications.
* Capture and document high\-quality **inspection images** of components and products.

**Nonconformance Management**

* Identify nonconforming product and generate accurate, timely **nonconformance reports**.
* Partner with engineering teams to support investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions related to quality issues.

**Data \& Documentation**

* Validate outgoing product data to ensure compliance with customer requirements.
* Perform accurate **data entry** and maintain up\-to\-date inventory information in the appropriate database systems.
* Follow detailed work instructions, SOPs, and documentation standards to maintain product traceability and compliance.

**Teamwork \& Operational Support**

* Work within a shift\-based team environment to support daily quality, engineering, and production activities.
* Contribute both as a collaborative team member and as an individual contributor to help meet daily inspection and production quotas.
* Follow a **compressed work schedule (3x4\)** as assigned.

**Work Environment \& Physical Requirements:**

* Role may involve frequent standing, repetitive hand motions, and handling small or delicate components.
* Work performed primarily in a clean‑room manufacturing setting, requiring adherence to gowning and contamination‑control procedures.
* May require exposure to chemicals, specialty tools, microscopes, or precision measurement equipment.
* Must follow all required safety protocols, wear appropriate PPE and clean‑room attire (full coverall suit, hairnet, mask, gloves, etc.) for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs.

**Skills:**

Clean Room Manufacturing, Communication, Computer Literacy, Data Entry, Hand Dexterity, Microscope, Microsoft Office, Problem Solving, Working Independently**Education \& Experience:**

Less than 1 year of related experience. No formal occupational training is typically required \| Required**Pay Range:**


$19\.30 \- $25\.36**Pay Range Explained:**


This role in Livermore, California pays between $19\.30 and $25\.36 per hour, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit\-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**


FormFactor is an equal opportunity employer. FormFactor complies with all national, state, and local laws that seek to promote equal opportunities for any applicant or employee without regard to age, race, color, gender, gender identity/expression, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, disability, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, military service, or any other legally protected characteristics. These protections apply to all aspects of employment, including but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotions, and compensation.

  

For roles that are designated as remote\-eligible, employees cannot be located in: AL, AK, AR, DE, GA, HI, IL, IA, LA, ME, MD, MS, MO, NE, NV, NJ, NM, ND, OK, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, WV, WI, WY. This list is continuously evolving and being updated, please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. A role is remote\-eligible only when it is listed as "Remote" in the job location.

jobs.title: Program Manager III, Hardware NPI, Cloud Supply Chain
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience driving New Product Introduction (NPI) for hardware programs (e.g., PCBA, accelerators, equipment, racks, switches, optics).
* Experience with materials management (e.g., bill of materials (BOMs), contract manufacturers, supplier coordination, delivery material readiness, etc.).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Hardware supply chain experience driving products from prototype to mass production.
* Experience with supply planning and accounting/finance analytics.
* Ability to collaborate and influence across multiple levels of an organization and experience leading cross functional process improvements, using strong analytical and communication/facilitation skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As Program Manager, you will lead all aspects of supply chain readiness in New Product Introduction (NPI) products for our global data centers. You will work with cross\-functional teams starting with product inception to volume ramp to bring innovative products into global data centers efficiently and dynamically. You will demonstrate domain expertise in material readiness, clear to build, supplier and contract manufacturer management, procurement, manufacturing, supply resiliency, and are well versed in other aspects of operations and engineering that impact supply chain strategies and execution.  

  

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing materials plans, enabling prototype builds and driving production ramp plans for products deployed in our data centers. Product types include networking, infrastructure, and server and storage. You will work closely with Engineering, Supply Chain Operations, Supply and Demand Planning, Contract Manufacturing, and Supplier partners to launch new products and to implement processes and systems that directly scale new product deployments.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive material and supply chain readiness for all NPI builds from concept phase to production handoff, partnering with cross\-functional teams to ensure success.
* Identify and communicate supply chain risks and mitigation plans to ensure materials readiness for NPI builds as well as enabling long term supply continuity into production.
* Be the primary materials liaison with ODM/CM/Suppliers, manage spend against project budgets, and drive large production risk buys and strategic buffers.
* Develop and document global supply chain map for each product, including suppliers, procurement model, lead time, shipment logistics, assembly/test/fulfillment model, and spares strategies.
* Update project schedules, communicate status, risks and influence change, and represent the New Product Introduction Supply Chain organization in internal program meetings, driving initiatives and process improvements to help the team grow in scalability.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Differential Response Program Manager
jobs.description:
**AGENCY DESCRIPTION:**

Instituto Familiar de la Raza, Inc. is a multi\-service community health \& social service agency with emphasis in serving the Chicano/Latino/Indigenous community in San Francisco with a special focus on the diverse needs of the Mission District. Services include a wide range of mental health, HIV related services, and social services including health promotion, education, prevention, early intervention, case management, clinical, psychological and psychiatric interventions as well as cultural/social and spiritual re\-enforcement. The agency serves children, youth, adults \& families; it has a rich history of working collaboratively with other agencies to meet the needs of the diverse Chicano/Latino/Indigenous communities, \& other cultural/racial communities in San Francisco.

**JOB/ PROGRAM DESCRIPTION:**

The Chicano/Latino Family Resource system (FRS) is a collaborative project of four community agencies. The project’s purpose is to combine the efforts and staff of the collaborating agencies to develop prevention, early intervention, and intensive case management programs and services which reinforce family preservation with high\-risk families residing in the Mission District and Chicano/Latino families throughout San Francisco.

The Differential Response (DR) program within FRS, works with fifteen partnered community agencies throughout San Francisco and with the Human Services Agency (HSA) to provide services to families referred to CPS and in need of additional support to prevent out of home placement and re\-referrals. This position supervises the Data and Training Specialist, as part of the Differential Response Team. Essential Job Duties are but not limited to the following:

*Program Leadership*

* Coordinate citywide Differential Response (DR) services by serving as the primary point of contact for HSA, FCS, and DEC, uplifting communication and effective service delivery
* Serve as a liaison with HSA and partner agencies by maintaining consistent communication on referrals, service outcomes, and program updates
* Support the ongoing implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of DR program procedures
* Lead implementation of the Family First Prevention Services Act (FFPSA) requirements as they relate to the DR program, ensuring compliance
* Develop and maintain annual schedules for DR\-related meetings, training, and site visits
* Support organizational and programmatic goals by participating in special projects, community events, and other related duties
* Provide leadership to DR Liaisons through consultation, coaching, and technical assistance
* Provide consultation and technical assistance to DR Liaisons and HSA staff citywide, strengthening capacity to respond effectively to family needs.
* Facilitate bi\-monthly DR Liaison meetings to foster collaboration, share resources, and promote alignment across agencies.

*Collaboration, Partnerships \& Communication*

* Lead and facilitate monthly DR Coordination Team meetings, Workgroup meetings, and Case Consultation sessions with CBO partners and HSA staff
* Collaborate with FCS Protective Service Workers, supervisors, and other representatives to determine the best fit for family needs (Red Team Meeting)
* Facilitate bi\-monthly DR Liaison meetings to foster collaboration, share resources, and promote alignment across agencies. (also relevant to capacity building)

*Referral Management \& Service Coordination*

* Triage and assign DR and SafeCare referrals received from HSA to appropriate partner agencies, ensuring timely and equitable service connection for families across the city, ensuring 95% of referrals are responded to within 2 working days

*Quality Assurance, Compliance \& Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI)*

* Conduct quarterly site visits and case chart reviews to ensure compliance with Standards of Quality for Family Strengthening and Support (SQFSS)
* Conduct quarterly quality assurance reviews of partner agencies, assessing compliance, program fidelity, and overall effectiveness of service delivery
* Develop progress reports and include outcomes in quarterly reports, framed in a CQI methodology

*Data Management, Evaluation \& Reporting*

* Prepare and manage Differential Response data collection, entry, and reporting across multiple platforms including FFPSA Master Tracker, CMS Carbon Report, statistical summaries, and quarterly progress reports to meet contractual and collaborative requirements.

**Required Skills:**

* Minimum of three years’ experience providing social services
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Access, Word, and Power Point and utilizing email communication ∙ Excellent written and oral skills in English
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and organizational skills
* Knowledge and sensitivity to issues of diversity including that of gender, race, language, sexual orientation and socio\-economic status
* Proven ability to communicate effectively under high stress situations; demonstrated diplomacy and sensitivity with clients under stress

**Preferred Skills:**

* Bilingual Spanish/English
* Advanced Excel skills (including Power Query) and familiarity with Microsoft 365 tool
* Knowledge and experience with the San Francisco FRC initiative
* Experience in a non\-profit community agency

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES:**

* Bachelor of Arts degree in Social Work or related field
* Complete annual recurrent DPH online training
* Must pass and maintain annual Tuberculosis Test
* Must pass Department of Justice Fingerprint screening

***PHYSICAL DEMANDS:***

The physical demands described here are representative of that which an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations can be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions

* Good general health, physical stamina and emotional stability are essential
* Ability to hear within normal range, and communicate effec

jobs.title: Orientation and Onboarding Program Manager - HR
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Orientation and Onboarding Program Manager to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of new hire orientation experiences in our NALA region for the United States, Canada, Brazil, and Mexico. In this role, you will be the architect of a new hire's first impression of our company by creating engaging, inclusive, and informative orientation programs that connect employees to our culture, values, and mission from the start.

 **What you'll be doing:**

* Orientation Program Ownership: Design, manage, and continuously evolve a world\-class new hire orientation program, including in\-person, virtual, and hybrid formats.
* Cultural Integration: Champion our company culture and values through immersive onboarding experiences that resonate across diverse geographies and backgrounds.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with HR, Communications, IT, Legal, Real Estate and Site Services (RESS), and many other groups to curate and deliver a seamless, end\-to\-end orientation experience.
* Content Creation \& Curation: Develop and maintain engaging orientation materials including presentations, welcome videos, new hire task lists, and digital resources.
* Facilitation \& Hosting: Serve as a primary facilitator and host for orientation sessions, creating an energetic and welcoming environment for new hires.
* Speaker \& Executive Coordination: Recruit, prepare, and schedule executive speakers and cross\-functional presenters to participate in orientation programming.
* Technology \& Platforms: Manage orientation delivery platforms and tools to ensure a consistent and accessible experience for all new hires.
* Continuous Onboarding: Manage and develop continuous onboarding programs post\-orientation. This may include New Hire Office Hours, Socials, Volunteer Events and much more.

jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

* Partner closely with our Employer Customer Success Team to ensure customers adopt and are successful on Handshake

* Enlist and inspire customers to participate in Handshake events and other marketing materials
* Manage overall customer loyalty, serving as internal advocate and escalation point to customers
* Assist in identifying and developing scalable account management tools and methodologies that can be applied across the Account Management team  

Help scale internal process to support hundreds of premium employers
* Becoming a Handshake expert, learning the ins and outs of HR and higher ed Tech

 *Must be willing to work onsite from our SF or NY office\- expected 5 days a week.*

**You Have**

* At least 2\+ years of sales experience in Enterprise SaaS sales or Account Management, 5\+ years in a closing and quota carrying role
* Experience preparing renewal proposals, forecasting, and account planning
* A strong history of quota attainment and excellent performance on a high\-reaching team  

Experience with an evangelical sale, selling non\-discretionary software to executives at Fortune 1000 companies
* Experience managing customer relationships alongside a Customer Success team
* Experience using usage, data and results to demonstrate value and justify expansion
* An impeccable communicator with polished and professional sales presentation skills
* Experience operating in a high\-growth business environment like Handshake

------------


Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life.

***The below benefits are for full\-time US employees.***


**Ownership:** Equity in a fast\-growing company


**Financial Wellness**: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching


**Family Support:** Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching


**Wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend


**Growth:** $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development


**Remote \& Office:** Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office


**Time Off:** Flexible PTO, 15 holidays \+ 2 flex days


**Connection:** Team outings \& referral bonuses


Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers.


Compensation Range: $179\.2K \- $224K

jobs.description:
**Location:** Walnut Creek, California
We inspire purpose\-filled living that brings beauty and quality to the modern home. Together, we achieve. Associates across our business drive results, innovate, and inspire. Drawn together by our shared values and passion for our customers and our brands, we deliver home furnishings that are expertly designed, responsibly sourced, and bring timeless style and function to people’s homes. From the day we opened our first store in Chicago in 1962 to the digital innovations that engage millions of customers today, our iconic brand is over 60 years in the making—and our story is still unfolding.



We’re here for it. We think ***you should be too.***


Our Seasonal Operations Associates are at the core of our customers’ experience. Friendly, outgoing and naturally driven, they are enthusiastic brand ambassadors who tend to love our amazing associate discount! A fan of all things home, their enthusiasm brings a level of excitement to our stores that makes shopping fun, engaging and keeps customers coming back. With leadership and mentoring support from your leader, Operations Associates ensure our shelves are filled, our displays are complete and our stock room stays prepped and “at the ready” to fulfill customer orders in our stores. The heartbeat of a store’s operation, these roles are largely behind the scenes but help us deliver exceptional customer service and drive sales. We’d love to talk to you about how a seasonal position with CBH could be a fun and flexible holiday opportunity as part of a diverse and innovative team.
**A day in the life as a Seasonal Operations Associate...**

* Perform prompt and accurate stock checks, while maintaining an organized and efficient stockroom.
* Assist the leadership team with ensuring product and displays on the sales floor are stocked appropriately and available for customers to purchase.
* Process incoming and outgoing packages, including customer curbside pick\-up orders, ship from store, and buy online, pick up in store, in a timely manner.
* Support and maintain store sales and service goals and standards as communicated by the leadership team.
* Drive sales through engagement of customers, sharing and demonstrating product knowledge and product expertise, as needed.
* Lead by example and support store leadership in holding self and others accountable for store profitability and operational excellence.
* Have awareness of current promotions, brand initiatives/events, store services, collaborations, and promote them to customers.
* Maintain an awareness of loss prevention, security and safety following the guidelines provided by leadership and/or as outlined in the Associate Policy Manual.
* Promote a strong sense of teamwork by working together safely, effectively, respectfully and efficiently with all associates.

**What you'll bring to the table...**

* Customer service or retail experience preferred
* Good communication skills
* Ability to move and/ or lift up to 50 pounds; heavier merchandise with team assist
* Must be able to work the weekend after Thanksgiving AND the days surrounding Christmas
* Part\-Time roles: Availability to work two or more weekend days (Friday, Saturday, and/or Sunday) and at least one weekday or night

  

  

**Starting Rate:** $18\.00 \- $22\.50

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data\-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.


But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020\. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin\-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward\-thinking, innovative force in the market.


Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting\-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.


Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.


Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

 **Job Description** **The Role**: As a Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Strategy, you will serve as the primary bridge between our enterprise customers and Strategy's engineering, product, and go\-to\-market teams. You will own the full post sales lifecycle of a customer account portfolio, ensuring customers do not simply "use" the platform but deeply integrate Strategy's cloud\-native architecture, Semantic Layer (Mosaic), and AI\-powered analytics capabilities into their core technology stack.


Your goal is to drive measurable business value and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by ensuring the platform is technically optimized, strategically adopted, and commercially positioned to expand.

**Location (Preferred)**: This role is ideally based in the San Francisco Bay Area, CA. Candidates located in the Bay Area are strongly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Technical Strategy \& Customer Success**

* Act as the lead technical advisor for your accounts, guiding customers through complex cloud\-native architectures, Semantic Layer (Mosaic) implementations, and AI\-driven analytics workflows.
* Leading C\-suite whiteboard sessions to align platform capabilities with high\-level business goals.

* Serve as a high\-level technical point of contact for complex support escalations, coordinating between the customer's engineering team and Strategy's internal developers to drive timely resolution.
* Advise customers on platform enhancements, integrations, and upgrades — ensuring alignment with the Strategy product roadmap and the customer's long\-term data strategy.

* Partner with Sales and Account Management to identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities, providing account health insights and adoption data that inform commercial strategy.
* Proactively identify renewal risks and collaborate with Sales and leadership on mitigation plans before they escalate.
* Develop strong referenceable customers willing to participate in case studies, testimonials, reference calls, and industry events.

  

**Qualifications** **Core Technical Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience) required.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-native services (microservices, Kubernetes, Docker) and major cloud pro

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bland AI**


At Bland, we’re building the most human AI phone agents in the world.


We’re a Series C startup backed by Emergence Capital, Y Combinator, and the founders of PayPal and Twilio, and we’ve raised $100M to reimagine the future of customer communication. Today, we’re a 60 person team powering voice automation for companies like Better.com, helping them deliver friendly, helpful, and human\-like conversations at massive scale.


And now we’re hiring our next game\-changing teammate: a Customer Success Manager (CSM) who lives at the intersection of customer success, and solutions.  

  

**Why this role exists**

  

We need someone who will take control of post\-sales, enforce clarity, and drive customers to value fast. Someone who doesn’t wait for direction, they build the plan, run the room, unblock deployments, collapse timelines, and turn customer confusion into clean, repeatable execution. Someone who can stabilize accounts, surface real risks, tighten the feedback loop, and aggressively identify expansion opportunities.

  

That’s the founding Customer Success Manager: the person who owns outcomes, commands the customer relationship, and turns our product into an undeniable business impact at speed.  

  

**What you'll do**

* **Drive Customer Outcomes** \- You’ll own the post\-sales journey end\-to\-end, ensuring every customer launches quickly, hits quantifiable KPIs, and sees unmistakable ROI from our agents. That means diagnosing blockers before they become problems, pushing customers toward high\-value use cases, and turning every deployment into a measurable win for both their business and ours.
* **Cross\-Functional Problem Solving** \- Partner with forward deployed engineers to troubleshoot issues, accelerate resolutions, and ensure customers stay successful in production.
* **Proactive Technical Guidance** \- Educate customers on best practices, new features, and optimization strategies, helping them get more value from Bland with every interaction.
* **Customer Growth \& Expansion** \- Work closely with customers to uncover new use cases, map expansion opportunities, and translate insights into actionable growth plans.
* **Executive \& Technical Communication \-** Engage confidently with stakeholders at every level, simplifying complex AI behavior into clear recommendations that drive adoption and outcomes.
* **High\-Ownership, High\-Velocity Mindset** \- Operate with positivity, pace, and accountability in a fast\-moving startup environment where speed, precision, and customer obsession matter.
* **Driver of Customer Outcomes \-** Help customers achieve measurable business results with the most friendly, helpful, and human\-like AI phone agents in the world.

 **Qualifications**

* **5\+ Years in Technical Customer\-Facing Roles \-** Experience as a TAM, CSM, Deployment Strategist or similar role owning post\-sales success and enterprise customer outcomes.
* **API \& Integration Exposure \-** Interpreting logs, querying data with SQL and understanding how systems integrate in production.
* **Escalation \& Incident Management \-** Skilled in resolving complex issues, guiding senior stakeholders, and driving clarity during high\-pressure situations.
* **Strong Communication Skills \-** Able to simplify technical concepts for executives and dive deep with practitioners.
* **High EQ \& Customer Advocacy \-** Builds trust quickly, navigates competing priorities, and proactively guides customers towards best practices through structured touchpoints such as MBR/QBRs.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration \-** Proven success partnering with Sales, and Engineering, to drive adoption and growth.
* **Thrives in Fast\-Paced Environments \-** High\-ownership operator who excels in rapid, high\-impact cultures.

 **Nice to haves**

* Startup experience or early\-stage CSM experience
* Experience with AI/ML, conversational AI, or telephony systems
* Familiarity with debugging distributed systems, logs, or APIs beyond REST/JSON
* Background working with voice workflows, call flows, or contact center tech
* Experience building CSM playbooks or customer onboarding frameworks

 **Why You’ll Love This Role**


You get to build real AI systems that talk, reason, and help humans at scale and you’re the one bringing that magic into production for customers across entire industries.


You’ll be part of a small, elite team at the frontier of voice AI, with massive ownership and the chance to define what “best\-in\-class technical account management” means in the age of LLMs.


And if we do this right? You will have a measurable, outsized impact on Bland’s growth curve.  

  

**Compensation \& Perks**


Salary: $180k – $230k OTE \+ meaningful equity \+ benefits.


Gorgeous office in Levi's Plaza, San Francisco


We are open to remote for this position

 **Additional Information**  

*Bland is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to proving equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees and do not discriminate based on any legally protected characteristic.*  

  

*Bland participates in the E\-Verify employment verification program. All new hires are required to complete the Form I\-9, and employment will be verified though E\-Verify as part of the onboarding process.*


Compensation Range: $180K \- $230K

Our organization includes a strategic team of big thinkers and creatives who truly work interdependently. Whether planning our Customer Experience program, developing multi\-pronged marketing strategies, or designing projects for our innovative clients, we are constantly finding ways to underscore our promise to partner with our clients to make inspiring spaces that unlock their people’s greatest potential. The pace is fast, the learning is constant…but as part of a team this driven, the possibilities are endless.


**Your Role at Pivot**



As Operations Coordinator 1, you will be responsible for all Service Operations work\-order transfers into the Company’s scheduling software and for soft scheduling orders and projects. You will ensure orders are ready to dispatch and report blockers and work with team to ensure success of dispatch. The work you do is highly nuanced and requires a strong attention to detail with ability to effectively coordinate and communicate between a multitude of internal parties.


**In Addition, You Will**

* Review all project particulars including labor PO, hours, etc. prior to scheduling ensuring the project will be executed correctly. Follow up with internal departments for missing project details as needed.
* Collaborate as necessary with key stakeholders to ensure the project succeeds.
* Print all required paperwork for installation staff including work orders, prints, and field paperwork.
* Create product pull lists for the warehouse staff and Receiving Coordinator.
* Perform other duties or special projects assigned.


**We’re Excited About You If You Have**

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. None.

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
Stuut is transforming how B2B companies turn revenue into cash. Businesses worldwide have trillions tied up in receivables, yet the work between order and payment still relies on fragmented systems and labor\-intensive manual processes. Stuut’s AI agent works across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, carrying context through every step. Customers reduce DSO by 47%, collect 40% more cash and eliminate 70% of manual work without replacing their ERP.  

  

Stuut is already trusted by finance teams at companies including Honeywell, NCR and ZoomInfo, from Fortune 10 enterprises to scaling mid\-market businesses. We are backed by a16z, Khosla Ventures, Activant, 1984 Ventures, Page One and Microsoft.

**The Role**
------------

Stuut is seeking its first Sales Enablement hire to build the function for our Account Executive and BDR teams. Our sales org is growing quickly and selling a product that rapidly evolves to finance buyers. This role owns how sellers ramp, how they tell the Stuut’s story, and how they get better every quarter.


This is an individual contributor role reporting into Revenue Operations. It is hands\-on: you will set the strategy and also write the onboarding curriculum, record the demo, build the battlecard, and run call reviews. You will partner closely with Sales leadership, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Finance.

**What you'll do**
------------------


Onboarding and ramp

* Design and run a repeatable onboarding program for new BDRs, andAEs, with a defined bar for what "ramped" means at each role and clear ramp\-time targets
* Own the first 30/60/90 for every new seller, including product certification, pitch and demo certification, tooling proficiency, and territory readiness
* Build in feedback loops so every cohort improves the next one


Messaging, pitch, and demo

* Codify the Stuut pitch into a single, current, opinionated narrative that every seller can deliver the same way
* Build and maintain the standard demo flow for each product surface and keep it current as the product ships
* Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, use cases, buyer personas, and vertical narratives


Ongoing enablement and coaching

* Run a regular enablement cadence (weekly rep\-facing sessions, monthly deep dives, quarterly kickoffs) driven by what the field actually needs
* Build a live call\-review and coaching program with Sales leadership, using recorded calls to reinforce what good looks like and surface where reps are getting stuck
* Own the enablement content library — playbooks, talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handles, competitive battlecards, ROI framing — and keep it usable, current, and findable


Product\-to\-field translation

* Sit close to Product to translate each release into "what this means for the field": what to say, who to say it to, when to bring it up, and what proof to lean on
* Build a launch process that turns product updates into field readiness quickly and consistently


Sales methodology and skill development

* Partner with Sales leadership to select and operationalize the qualification and deal\-management framework that fits Stuut's motion — training, reinforcement, coaching, and inspection
* Build role\-specific skill programs (discovery, multi\-threading, negotiation, executive presence, technical selling to CFOs)


Measurement and iteration

* Define what enablement is accountable for: ramp time to first deal, pitch and demo certification pass rates, win rate on contested deals, content adoption, and manager coaching consistency
* Report against those metrics and kill programs that do not move them

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 6\+ years in sales enablement, sales training, sales operations, or a quota\-carrying / sales\-adjacent role at a B2B software company, with clear ownership of a program you built end to end
* A track record of building or scaling enablement from zero or near\-zero — you have been the first or second enablement hire before, or you have owned a function that ran like one
* Strong instincts for sales messaging and translating a complex, fast\-moving technical product into a story that sellers can tell and buyers can act on
* Fluency running coaching and call reviews with sellers and Sales leadership — you can spot what a rep needs from listening to five minutes of a call
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with Sales leadership, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Finance
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* Willingness to be in the San Francisco or New York office four days per week

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a Series A–D company selling a fast\-changing product to a mix of technical and business buyers
* Background enabling direct sales with an enterprise motion
* Experience selling or enabling into AI, finance, or accountanting
* Familiarity with modern enablement and revenue tooling (CRM, LMS, conversation intelligence, content management)
* Previous time as an AE, SDR, or SC before moving into enablement

**Compensation**

* Top\-of\-market salary and equity package
* Benefits (for U.S.\-based full\-time employees)
* Medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you
* 401(k) \& Match
* Equity
* Flexible PTO
* Parental Leave

jobs.title: Clinical Support Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us**



Hyperfine, Inc. (Nasdaq: HYPR) is the groundbreaking health technology company that has redefined brain imaging with the *Swoop**®*system—the first FDA\-cleared, portable, ultra\-low\-field, magnetic resonance brain imaging system capable of providing imaging at multiple points of care in a healthcare facility. Our mission is to revolutionize patient care globally through transformational, accessible, clinically relevant diagnostic imaging. Learn More


**About The Role**



Job Title**:**Clinical Support Specialist



The Clinical Support Specialist is responsible for all aspects of the initial training and support for the customer team, including physicians, nurses, radiographers, MRI Technologists, and other relevant personnel in the use of Hyperfine's Swoop Portable MRI System. This role will assist in optimizing customer experience by acting as a true consultant with regards to integrating the Swoop System within a customer's workflow and procedures. The person in this role will partner effectively to relay customer feedback to internal Hyperfine teams and will function as the clinical specialist during the product sales cycle in close collaboration with the Sales, Marketing, Clinical Science, and R\&D groups. They will also support clinical adoption, utilization, customer engagement, and related account activities for our customers.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Train hospital staff on the safe and effective use and operation of Hyperfine products within the clinical areas including amending workflow and optimize product value and utilization
* Provide customized training and support for new operators of the Swoop System and maintain strategic relationships and support post\-installation
* Develop and maintain relationships in accounts with key personnel within the hospital and consult on best practices and use cases
* Provide R\&D with clinical input and feedback for new projects
* Support the sales team by identifying customer needs and relaying potential opportunities within the existing installed base
* Support new product evaluation and clinical studies
* Support the centers in optimizing their standard procedures and workflows
* Support adoption and utilization activities and escalate retention or expansion opportunities
* Collaborate with the sales team by providing technical support in various sales cycles to win new business, including accompanying site visits as needed for demonstrations
* Work with the sales team to support Swoop utilization activities
* Support assigned opportunities to enhance client relationships and increase adoption within a facility or network.
* Partner with internal stakeholders (ex. sales, product, marketing, clinical sciences, clinical applications) to share feedback, identify trends, and make introductions that result in increased value for the customer and Hyperfine
* Identify potential attrition risks and product gaps and escalate them with recommended follow\-up actions.
* Work closely with teammates and/or RN counterparts to provide customer success to install base customers and future potential customers
* Represent Hyperfine and demonstrate products at trade shows and society meetings
* Support MRI peer champion and Key Opinion Leader (KOL) development activities.
* MRI safety and screening knowledge and analyzing contraindications regarding portable low field vs. high field MR
* MRI sequence and protocol understanding workflow optimization
* Support scanner software and firmware upgrades for customers
* Perform scanner implementations at customer sites
* Perform virtual and on site training of scanners to customers
* Participate in image review with customer physicians and Hyperfine medical officers
* Backup / support for image demonstrations
* Case review with healthcare staff
* Trade show image support and case reviews


**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL:**


* In\-depth knowledge reading of the critical care setting to make consultative clinical recommendations to optimize procedures
* Experience working with a variety of stakeholders including physicians, business administration, clinical, etc.
* Ability to build effective relationships with customer stakeholders and support adoption of clinical workflows
* Strong problem solver with sound judgment
* Hands on, strong team player, and fully accountable for delivering agreed\-upon tactical performance metrics
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Highly organized and able to multitask
* Articulate, analytical, technically savvy, and professional
* Strong computer skills
* Self\-driven and self sufficient
* Positive attitude and team player\-oriented individual
* Excellent time management, including managing daily schedule, travel plans, and expenses


**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**


* Associate's degree in Radiology Sciences or related field
* Registered Technologist with the ARRT (American Registry of Radiologic Technologists) and current credentialing in MR (Magnetic Resonance) or equivalent
* 3\+ years' experience in clinical MR imaging or similar experience such as 3\+ years X\-ray \+ 2 years in MRI in a hospital setting
* 2\+ years' experience operating in clinical applications or clinical training experience


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**


* Reside in assigned territory and ability to work from home\-based office
* Able to travel up to 75% of the time within and outside of territory, including occasional weekend travel
* Ability to work long hours and execute under pressure with short turnaround times
* Live near a major airport

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting\-edge AI\-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes.


As trailblazers in end\-to\-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post\-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance.


Our vision extends beyond mere problem\-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors.


Backed by leading investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Amplo, Boeing, and RTX Ventures, Axion is poised to lead the quality revolution in manufacturing.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the data foundation and onboarding experience of the Axion platform: how a customer's raw quality data becomes a workspace engineers trust, from data handoff to their first actionable issues to investigate and resolve.


Product quality problems affect safety, cost, and the people who use what manufacturers build. The data behind those issues arrives messy, inconsistent, and full of domain language. How well we turn it into something quality engineers can trust sets how fast customers launch, how much effort it takes us, and how good Axion's AI and agents are after launch. Your first priority is making onboarding fast and repeatable while keeping the data and AI output trustworthy. You'll set the product direction for how Axion understands customer data.


This is a senior individual contributor role working closely with Engineering, Design, Solutions, and Operations. You'll thrive here if you like getting into real customer data, working side by side with engineers, and building AI products people have to trust.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the path from data handoff to a usable workspace: data setup, transformations, mappings, readiness, and a customer's first useful issues.
* Collaborate with customers, engineering, and operations to define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our data products, aligning these with company goals and user needs.
* Turn manual setup work into repeatable product capability, so each new customer takes less time and internal effort to bring on.
* Decide how customer data is structured, linked, classified, and turned into issues, and how that evolves as the product and our AI change.
* Capture what Axion needs to know about a customer's products, components, and failure modes during onboarding, and use it to improve classification, seed the customer's knowledge hub, and give AI agents better context.
* Learn from every onboarding alongside Solutions, Operations, and customers, and feed what you learn back into the product.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 5\+ years of product management in B2B software, including a product built around messy customer data or AI output customers need to trust.
* Hands\-on data fluency: demonstrated experience owning data schemas, taxonomies, data ingestion pipelines, or similar data\-product surfaces
* Experience measuring AI output quality: you've defined what "correct" looks like, used labeled examples, and shown whether a change made results better.
* A track record of turning implementation, onboarding, or operations work into repeatable product, with internal teams as your first users.
* Customer and operator judgment: you can work directly with a customer and the team doing the setup, run a focused pilot, and decide how to improve the product experience from the results.
* Experience at a venture\-backed startup.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in manufacturing, quality, warranty, field service, or another complex operational domain.
* Background in data preparation, data quality, data labeling, or evaluation products.
* Experience with taxonomies, classification systems, knowledge capture, or designing context for AI agents.
* A past life in implementation, solutions, or customer onboarding before moving into product.

---------------


You’re a builder and operator who thrives in fast\-moving, high\-accountability environments. You take pride in getting things done — thoughtfully, efficiently, and without drama. You’re energized by ambiguity, skilled at bringing clarity, and comfortable flexing between strategy and execution.


You value feedback — giving it, receiving it, and acting on it — and you see collaboration as a competitive advantage, not a burden. You’re low\-ego but high\-agency: you care about winning as a team more than being right individually. You move quickly, communicate directly, and make decisions grounded in impact and data.


You don’t need constant direction — you create momentum. You take ownership for outcomes, and you expect the same from those around you.

**How We Operate**
------------------


We move fast, work smart, and hold ourselves to a high bar. Axion is a place for people who take pride in their craft and are motivated by meaningful work. We respect time off and boundaries, but we’re also realistic: hard problems sometimes require weekend pushes or late\-night thinking sessions. We support that balance — intensity with respect for recharge.

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.


Role Overview
  

The Program Manager, Compliance is a strategic driver of Stord’s operational strength and commercial growth. This role is responsible for scaling enterprise compliance programs across OSHA, EPA, GMP, and adjacent regulatory regimes \- building the infrastructure that enables Stord to operate with confidence, win in the market, and deliver on the compliance commitments that today’s leading brands require from a fulfillment partner. A mature, well\-run compliance program is not just a risk management function at Stord; it is a competitive differentiator that unlocks customer revenue, supports network expansion, and protects the business at scale.
  

  

Reporting to the Director of Health, Safety \& Security, this is an enterprise\-level, network\-wide role that operates at the intersection of compliance, operations, and growth. The Program Manager partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and Finance to ensure compliance capabilities are a strength Stord leads with \- enabling the business to pursue regulated customer segments, scale into new markets, and demonstrate the program maturity that top\-tier brands demand. The work product of this role is what the entire organization is built around: scalable written programs, audit frameworks, certification standards, reporting infrastructure, and regulatory intelligence systems that grow stronger as Stord grows.
**What This Role Owns**
=======================

This role owns the enterprise compliance program architecture \- the standards, written programs, audit frameworks, and governance mechanisms that define what ‘compliant’ looks like at every Stord facility. The work product of this role is what the rest of the organization is held accountable to. Specifically:


* Enterprise compliance program design, construction, and ownership across OSHA, EPA, GMP, GDP, DOT, and applicable state and local regulatory frameworks \- building programs from the ground up where gaps exist and elevating inconsistent standards to enterprise\-grade.
* Regulatory intelligence: continuously monitoring rulemaking, agency guidance, and enforcement trends; converting regulatory change into updated enterprise programs before gaps become violations.
* Enterprise audit and inspection framework: designing the internal audit program architecture, defining scope and methodology, and building the tools and cadences that keep the network inspection\-ready \- not conducting site audits, but building the system that governs them.
* Enterprise compliance documentation infrastructure: designing and owning the system of record for all written programs, SOPs, training requirements, certifications, and regulatory correspondence \- the single source of truth for compliance across the network.
* Customer and industry certification programs: GMP, GDP, CTPAT, TAPA, and other regulated operating standards required by Stord’s customer base.
* Regulatory agency relationships: serving as the primary compliance point of contact for OSHA, EPA, and other agencies at the program level.
* Enterprise compliance reporting, data, and dashboards: building the metrics infrastructure that gives the Head of HSS, senior leadership, and the broader business real\-time visibility into compliance performance, risk posture, and program health across the network.
* Enterprise compliance training architecture: defining what training is required, for whom, at what frequency, and in what format \- building the content and governance framework that regional and site teams deliver against.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

--------------------------------------

* Build and own Stord’s enterprise OSHA compliance program \- designing the written program architecture, establishing network\-wide standards, and creating the governance mechanisms that ensure consistent compliance across every facility regardless of size, volume, or operational complexity.
* Maintain and update OSHA\-required written programs: Hazard Communication, Lockout/Tagout, Respiratory Protection, Emergency Action Plans, Powered Industrial Truck programs, and others as applicable.
* Oversee OSHA recordkeeping standards across the network \- establishing recordkeeping protocols, auditing site\-level logs for accuracy, and managing 300A

jobs.description:
**Accounting Operations Manager — QuickBooks Online**

Sunistics Group \| Fully remote, U.S.\-based \| $32–$40 per hour

Flexible weekday scheduling, with availability beginning no later than 7 a.m. Pacific / 10 a.m. Eastern. Weekly hours and working schedule will be agreed before hiring.

**Own the accounting operation**

Sunistics Group delivers commercial solar projects. We need a hands\-on Accounting Operations Manager who takes responsibility for accurate books, reliable payment processing and consistent follow\-through. You will organise the work, resolve issues and keep management informed without needing reminders.

You will work with our existing accounting team and external accountant. This role combines ownership of the accounting workflow with doing the work in QuickBooks Online: reconciling accounts, reviewing records, coordinating approvals and processing payments.

**What you will own**

* Keep QuickBooks Online current each week. Review bank and credit\-card activity, match transactions correctly, maintain project classifications and resolve missing or duplicate entries.
* Own the month\-end checklist and agreed close deadlines. Reconcile bank and credit\-card accounts, investigate differences and provide complete supporting records to our accountant.
* Organise vendor invoices, statements and payment requests. Confirm documentation and approval, schedule and process authorised payments, and follow through on discrepancies.
* Manage crew reimbursement requests from receipt through approval and payment. Check receipts, amounts and project details, resolve missing information and ensure each payment is recorded once.
* Manage shared accounting inboxes and scanned incoming mail. Route requests, assign follow\-up and track deadlines so important items do not get lost.
* Coordinate priorities and review work across the accounting workflow. Maintain clear procedures, identify bottlenecks and escalate issues with a concise explanation and recommended next step.
* Keep cash\-planning inputs reliable, including expected payment dates and unresolved items, while reducing duplicate entry between QuickBooks and company spreadsheets.

**AI proficiency is required**

Using artificial intelligence to improve efficiency is an expectation of this role. You must already be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini or comparable tools for practical work—not simply interested in learning them later.

* Use company\-approved AI tools to simplify document handling, organise information, analyse spreadsheets, draft communications and document repeatable processes.
* Propose and implement useful improvements, checking whether they save time and improve accuracy.
* Verify AI output against original documents and accounting records. Protect confidential information and follow company rules for approved tools and data use. You remain responsible for accuracy; AI does not replace payment authorisation or accounting judgment.

We will ask for a brief example of an AI\-assisted workflow you have used and how you checked its results. Coding or building AI software is not required.

**What you bring**

* At least five years of relevant bookkeeping or accounting experience, including at least two years independently owning a recurring accounting cycle.
* Strong recent QuickBooks Online experience, including bank and credit\-card reconciliation, accounts payable, correcting errors and month\-end work.
* Evidence of taking ownership: setting priorities, resolving problems, coordinating others and meeting deadlines without repeated reminders.
* Practical AI experience, sound spreadsheet skills and confidence learning new systems.
* Clear written communication and good judgment when handling payments, vendor details and confidential records.
* U.S. residence and the ability to meet the stated weekday availability requirement.

Construction, trades or project\-based accounting experience is strongly preferred. QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is helpful. Demonstrated capability matters more than a particular degree or previous job title.

**What success looks like**

During your first 90 days, you will establish a dependable weekly accounting routine, own an agreed month\-end close schedule, make outstanding issues visible, and document the core payment and reimbursement workflows. You will also implement an agreed AI\-assisted improvement and demonstrate that its output is reliable.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and brief answers to our screening questions. Specific examples of work you personally owned are more useful than broad descriptions of your strengths. Shortlisted applicants will have a focused interview and professional reference checks. No take\-home exercise is required.

Pay: $65,539\.45 \- $83,148\.59 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Describe a business whose accounting cycle you personally owned. What did you do in QuickBooks Online, roughly how many accounts or transactions did you handle, and how did you know month\-end was complete? Include how you tracked unfinished work or reviewed work completed by others. Please use 3–5 sentences.
* A $1,250 vendor bill is already in QuickBooks. Its approved credit\-card payment appears in the credit\-card feed. A colleague has also entered a separate $1,250 expense for the same purchase. What would you check, and how would you resolve it? Please use 2–4 sentences.
* A vendor payment deadline is today, but new bank details arrived by email. A crew reimbursement request is also urgent and has no receipts or project information. What would you do first, what would you hold, and what would you tell management? Please use 2–4 sentences.
* Name an AI tool you have actually used for accounting or administrative work. Describe one specific task, what it improved, and how you checked the result and handled confidential information. Please use 3–5 sentences. Do not i

jobs.title: Project Manager - Broadcast Media
jobs.description:
**About Diversified:**  

Diversified is a global leader in audiovisual and media technology. We design and build innovative spaces and experiences for clients across industries such as corporate, entertainment, sports, retail, and government. Our team partners with organizations around the world to create environments that connect people through technology.
  
  

**What to Expect:**  

At Diversified, you’ll work on exciting and complex projects with opportunities to grow your career. We offer a collaborative and flexible work environment, competitive pay and benefits, and a culture that values diversity, inclusion, and innovation. If you’re ready to grow, create, and make an impact, Diversified is the place to do it.
  
  

**How You’ll Contribute:**  

A project manager (PM) is responsible for the scope, schedule, cost, quality and client satisfaction of a project throughout its entire lifecycle, from Initiating through Closing phases. However, the PM depends on the help of other people to perform most of the actual activities of the project. A project manager’s role is primarily focused around written and verbal communication to all project stakeholders.
  
The PM is responsible for overseeing, and performing project management functions on all AVE projects, budgets and scopes. The PM will act as the person responsible on their assigned projects and have direct control over all project activities.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

Daily activities include project communications, scheduling, task lists for technicians, managing deliverables from engineering, CAD and Programming and overseeing the completion of projects. The PM is responsible for completing systems integration projects on time, on budget and achieving high customer satisfaction from our customers.
  
The majority of this employee's time will be spent managing projects and communicating with all project stakeholders. This person will be helping to constantly improve the established Diversified processes.
  
As the primary interface to the client, the project manager develops a strong long\-term relationship.
  
They manage the client relationship, including expectations, communications and satisfaction.
  
* Coordinates and communicates.
* Provides clear leadership and ownership for the project within Diversified, including accurate and timely verbal and written communication and follow up.
* Coordinates all activities associated with the timely, accurate and on\-budget
* completion of the project, including engaging stakeholders, delegating responsibilities
* clearly and running client and internal project meetings.
* Provides support and assistance to team members as needed in order help them be
* successful and get the job done.
* Ensures appropriate and frequent communication between stakeholders.
* Resolves destructive conflict.
* Designs, plans, and coordinates work teams with regard to AVE installation projects
* Assumes ownership of individual projects and assignments
* Establishes and maintains communication with Account Executives, Directors, installation technicians, subcontractors, clients, etc.
* Develops and communicates project updates as required.
* Provides constant monitoring of labor, equipment and materials budgets.
* Provides and/or directs technical and administrative support to project team members.
* Develops and maintains all related project schedules.
* Performs field verification of prospective work site. Documents all issues with site and keeps everyone informed of potential issues and solutions.
* Coordinates all drawings and documentation between all internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitates and directs design reviews to assure proper documentation in the field.
* Coordinates all system programming and final checkout of systems. Provides punch\-list of remaining tasks after substantial completion.
* Contracts with contractors and other trades when necessary.
* Monitors status of projects including cost, timing and staffing to ensure timely and accurate completion of projects.
* Ensures quality and continuous improvement.
* Coordinates training \& turnover of projects to client, service department, \& sales.


**Complexity:**  

Every project is different and every set of project stakeholders is different. The PM needs to negotiate a very complex set of variables between system design, site conditions and a widely varying set of expectations with multiple stakeholders. The skill of communicating both verbally and in writing to manage all these variables takes a very high level of awareness, emotional intelligence and people management skills. The PM is constantly managing the forces of change in every project environment. Balancing schedules, budgets, scope, quality and client satisfaction are a very complex
  
set of variables.
  
  

**Decision Making Authority:**  

1\. Takes full ownership of project
  
a. Acts as the single point of responsibility and accountability for the project.
  
b. Ensures schedule performance, quality of solution delivered to client, and client
  
satisfaction.
  
c. Manages and reports on the project’s financials, including ensuring budget
  
performance and profitability. Ensures timely and correct billings to client.
  
d. Demonstrates proactivity, responsiveness, and follow through.
  
2\. Communicates decision options to stakeholders and manages those decisions.
  
3\. Manages a complex array of decisions at every point of the project but is rarely the sole
  
decision maker.
  
  

**Physical Working Environment:****Physical Demands:**  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that may be met by an
  
employee. The employee may be exposed to construction site conditions on a regular
  
basis. Employee will be responsible for their safety while on job sites and to comply with all safety
  
regulations in place by the GC. Use of PPE is usually required on job sites. The employee can typically
  
spend at least 40% of their time

Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients.
