jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician
jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------



With direction from the QA Inspection Supervisor(s) and Quality Management perform dimensional inspections on machined and molded components manufactured from internal and external sources per engineering drawings and applicable external standards. Maintains inspection equipment including Vertex and Vectors. Also maintains control of products on hold.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------



Perform first article and final product inspections working from engineering drawings, procedures, and external standards, using typical inspection equipment such as micrometers, thread gauges, calipers, optical comparator, concentricity gauge, and height \& depth gages.


Perform receiving inspection of Finished Goods and components using typical inspection equipment.


Perform component testing utilizing various inspection equipment such as tensile testers, force gages and custom equipment.


Complete and maintain all QA paperwork in accordance with established procedures and manufacturing practices including the generation of receiving and inspection records, first article reports, discrepant material reports, QA history log sheets, and document change requests (DCR’s) as required. Ensure all handwritten documentation is clear and legible.


Support the qualification/validation of new products/process projects; perform specialized inspections to help engineering develop new products, gages, and inspection methods.


Follow written procedures and engineering specifications utilized for inspection and ensure documents are kept current and adequate for the inspections performed. Provide feedback to QA Management on documents requiring updates or error correction.


Interact with personnel from departments outside of the Quality Inspection department, i.e. Manufacturing, Materials, Engineering, etc, to improve on overall Quality of product entering into the QA Inspection department.


Generate Non\-conformance Reports for submitted product found out of specification. Coordinates movement/control/disposition of products that are under investigation for non\- conformance. Coordinate shipment of Finished Goods scrap for destruction. Generate Quality Hold documents and coordinate containment of affected product.


Publish various daily quality related reports.


Perform additional duties as assigned by supervisor.


Using typical MS Office software (Word, Excel, and Outlook) create and perform simple data entry tasks and procedure changes as requested by QA Management.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------



Ability to use typical measuring devices (micrometer, caliper, comparator, thread gages, go/nogo gages and custom gages) and test instruments (pull and torque testers).


Experience in medical device manufacturing and / or clean room is a plus.


Working knowledge of sampling techniques (e.g., ANSI Z1\.4\.), Good Manufacturing Practices and other regulatory standards required.


Ability to read standard operating procedures engineering drawings; Ability to lift boxes less than 50 lbs


Attention to detail


Ability to work independently


Good organizational and communication skills

**Your Background**
-------------------



High school Diploma or GED required.


Minimum of 5 years applicable experience required.


Work experience in an ISO and/or regulated industry environment preferred

-------------------------

-----------------------

This role provides the opportunity to support clients across the food and consumer products industries, helping organizations strengthen quality systems, prepare for regulatory inspections, implement food safety programs, and maintain compliance with applicable FDA and industry requirements.

jobs.title: Healthcare Claims Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Healthcare Claims Implementation Specialist serves as InfoMC’s primary domain authority for healthcare claims operations during new client onboarding engagements on the Incedo claims platform. This individual bridges the gap between client operational workflows and the technical capabilities of the Incedo solution, ensuring that each implementation is aligned with payer\-side business requirements, regulatory obligations, and industry standards for electronic data interchange (EDI).

The BA/SME works directly with health plan and managed care organization clients to define requirements, configure workflows, validate transaction sets, and guide teams through end\-to\-end claims lifecycle processes—from member eligibility through remittance and adjudication. The ideal candidate brings deep payer\-side experience with HIPAA\-mandated EDI transactions, CMS reporting requirements, and the operational realities of claims processing within Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health plan environments.

What the Healthcare Claims Implementation Specialist Does:

***Claims Domain Expertise \& Client Advisory***

* Serve as the internal and client\-facing subject matter expert on healthcare claims operations, EDI transaction standards, and payer\-side adjudication logic throughout the Incedo onboarding lifecycle
* Translate client payer workflows and claims processing requirements into detailed business and functional specifications for the Incedo implementation team
* Advise clients on best practices for configuring claims intake, adjudication rules, coordination of benefits (COB), appeals and grievance workflows, and remittance processing within Incedo
* Identify gaps between client legacy processes and Incedo capabilities; document and escalate to product/engineering as applicable
* Support clients in designing claims data migration strategies, including crosswalks from legacy systems and validation of historical claims data integrity

***EDI Transaction Set Knowledge \& Validation***

The BA/SME must possess hands\-on functional knowledge of the following HIPAA\-mandated ASC X12 transaction sets and their application in a payer environment:

* 834 – Benefit Enrollment and Maintenance: member eligibility file intake from CMS, employer groups, or TPAs; validation of enrollment spans, plan codes, and subscriber/dependent relationships
* 270 / 271 – Eligibility Inquiry and Response: real\-time and batch eligibility verification, configuration of response logic and benefit information, and integration with member enrollment systems
* 837P / 837I – Professional and Institutional Claims: inbound claims intake, loop and segment validation, NPI/taxonomy routing, and coordination with Incedo adjudication engine
* 835 – Healthcare Claim Payment/Advice (ERA): remittance generation, CAS segment coding, ERA reconciliation against adjudicated claims, and ERA/EFT pairing
* 276 / 277 – Claim Status Request and Response: outbound claims status inquiry workflows, 277CA acknowledgment processing, and payer\-to\-provider communication configuration
* 278 – Health Care Services Review (Prior Authorization): inbound and outbound PA request/response workflows, integration with Incedo utilization management module, and CMS\-0057\-F electronic PA compliance
* 275 – Patient Information (Additional Information to Support a Health Care Claim): receipt and routing of clinical attachments and supporting documentation submitted by providers in conjunction with claims, including coordination with Incedo adjudication workflows requiring medical records or authorization documentation
* 999 / TA1 – Functional Acknowledgment and Interchange Acknowledgment: EDI gateway configuration, acknowledgment tracking, and error\-handling workflows

***Onboarding \& Implementation Execution***

* Lead business analysis workstreams during new client onboarding, including requirements discovery sessions, workflow mapping, and gap analysis documentation
* Develop and maintain detailed business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, data mapping templates, and EDI companion guides customized to each client’s trading partner environment
* Coordinate with the client’s EDI team and clearinghouse partners to complete end\-to\-end transaction testing for all applicable X12 transaction sets
* Facilitate and support user acceptance testing (UAT) for claims processing scenarios, ensuring adjudication outcomes align with client benefit plan configuration and state/federal requirements
* Document client\-specific configurations, workflow decisions, and known edge cases in InfoMC’s implementation knowledge base
* Partner with Engagement Managers and Technical Leads to ensure claims\-related milestones are on track, risks are escalated promptly, and client expectations are managed

***Regulatory \& Compliance Alignment***

* Maintain current knowledge of CMS regulations, HIPAA transaction and code set standards (45 CFR Part 162\), and state Medicaid agency requirements as they affect claims operations
* Advise clients on compliance with CMS\-0057\-F (electronic prior authorization), No Surprises Act (NSA) claims adjudication timelines, and applicable state prompt pay laws
* Support clients in Medicare Advantage (Part C), Medicaid managed care, and CHIP programs in configuring Incedo to meet CMS encounter data submission requirements
* Monitor and communicate updates to X12 transaction standards, ICD/CPT/HCPCS code set releases, and CMS NCCI edits that may affect client configurations

***Knowledge Sharing \& Continuous Improvement***

* Develop and maintain internal training materials, job aids, and onboarding playbooks related to claims operations and EDI workflows on the Incedo platform
* Mentor junior implementation staff on payer claims concepts, EDI troubleshooting, and client\-facing discovery techniques
* Collaborate with InfoMC’s Product and Engineering teams to communicate client\-driven enhancem

jobs.title: REMOTE Learning Program Manager, International Programs
jobs.description:
**REMOTE Learning Program Manager, International Programs**

The future of learning deserves the right talent. CapeTalent connects AI\-forward Learning \& Development professionals with Fortune 100 companies driving innovation at scale.


**CONTRACT DETAILS**W2 employment is not available for this engagement.
* 1099/C2C Only
* **EST HOURS**
* 6\-month contract (strong likelihood of extension)
* **REMOTE**
* Start date: October 2026
* 40 hours per week @ $55\-$65/hour (C2C or 1099\), based on experience
* Standard U.S. business hours
* Heavy Slack collaboration \+ Laptop provided
* **EST Hours**
* **Portfolio REQUIRED**


**The Opportunity**

As Learning Program Manager, International Programs, you'll design and manage the training programs that prepare our Experts in the UK, Canada, and Australia, and keep them in step with our US programs. When the US training changes, you'll decide what each international program needs, design the solution, and work with our Instructional Designers to bring it to life.


This role blends learning design and program management. You'll use your instructional design skills to shape learning journeys that build real job skills, and your organizational skills to keep many updates moving across three regions. It's a great fit for someone who is organized, detail\-oriented, and enjoys working with a team spread across time zones. If you've designed and managed training, onboarding, or enablement programs and have experience with accounting or bookkeeping software, we'd love to hear from you.


**What You'll Do**

**Keeping Programs Aligned Across Markets**

* Keep an eye on changes to US training and assess how they affect the UK, Canadian, and Australian programs.
* Compare US and international programs to identify content that needs to be updated, adapted for the local market, added, or removed.
* Tell the difference between product changes that apply everywhere and local differences (e.g., tax, payroll, compliance, and terminology) so each program stays accurate for its learners.
* Keep a clear, current view of where each international program stands compared with the US version.

**Designing Learning Programs**

* Conduct needs analyses to define clear, measurable, performance\-based learning outcomes tied to job success.
* Design learning journeys, curricula, and course outlines for international learners, including onboarding, product, and process training.
* Apply instructional design methods (e.g., ADDIE, SAM) and adult learning principles to build engaging, accessible learning with meaningful practice and scenarios.
* Design assessments and knowledge checks that confirm learners are ready for the job.

**Working with Instructional Designers**

* Turn identified gaps into clear, prioritized update requests for the Instructional Design team.
* Give designers the context, source materials, and expectations they need to make changes efficiently.
* Review updated content for accuracy and consistency before it goes live.

**Program Management**

* Manage updates from start to finish: intake, prioritization, scheduling, tracking, review, and launch.
* Juggle timelines and workloads across multiple updates at once using project trackers and checklists.
* Build and improve repeatable processes for keeping international programs in sync with the US.
* Spot bottlenecks early and suggest practical fixes.

**Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the main point of contact between US and international learning teams.
* Work Eastern Time hours to collaborate in real time with overseas teammates.
* Share progress, risks, and milestones clearly with leadership and partner teams, and raise issues early.

**Measuring Results \& Improving**

* Track program metrics such as content accuracy, learner engagement, completion, and effectiveness across regions.
* Gather and act on feedback from learners and stakeholders in each market.
* Keep program documentation, course materials, and change records up to date in the LMS and related systems.

**Qualifications**

**Must\-Have**

* Experience managing learning or training programs end to end (e.g., Learning Program Manager, Training Manager, L\&D Program Manager, Enablement Manager, or similar).
* Strong instructional design skills: needs analysis, learning objectives, curriculum and course design, and applying adult learning principles.
* Hands\-on experience with accounting or bookkeeping software, whether as a user, trainer, support specialist, bookkeeper, or accountant.
* Located on the US East Coast, or able to consistently work Eastern Time hours to align with our overseas team.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience managing programs or projects that involve several teams or departments.
* Experience with training programs for more than one country or region, or adapting content for different audiences.
* Familiarity with tax, bookkeeping, accounting, or payroll, especially differences between the US, UK, Canada, and Australia.
* Experience leading or partnering with Instructional Designers and eLearning developers.
* Experience with training for customer support, service, or other customer\-facing teams.
* Experience with any LMS or learning platform (e.g., Degreed, Docebo, Credly, Cornerstone, Workday Learning), and authoring tools such as Articulate Rise or Storyline.
* Comfortable with project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Smartsheet) and Agile or similar ways of working.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and experience working with remote, distributed teams.
* Bachelor's degree required; a Master's in Instructional Design, Education, Business, or a related field is a plus.

jobs.description:
About Blooma

Blooma is a commercial real estate (CRE) lending and underwriting platform. We help lenders move faster by pulling data out of rent rolls, operating statements, and appraisals so their underwriters can focus on decisions instead of data entry. A big part of that speed comes from our parsing pipeline, a mix of automation and a team of human parsers who make sure the data is right.

The Role

We're hiring a Parsing Operations Team Lead to run the day\-to\-day of our parsing operation. You'll be the point person for our offshore parsing team (managed through our partner Pointing Fish), making sure their work, both document parsing and Blooma platform QA during deployments, is flowing, high quality, and unblocked.

This is a good fit for someone early in their career who's organized, communicative, and comfortable working with a distributed team. You don't need a technical background. You need to be sharp, reliable, and good at keeping things on track.

What You'll Do

* Own day\-to\-day throughput and quality of the offshore parsing team's work, across both document parsing and Blooma platform QA during deployments
* Handle escalations from the parsing team by unblocking questions, clarifying requirements, and looping in Blooma engineering or product when needed
* Coordinate with the US team (product, engineering, customer success) so priorities and blockers stay visible
* Support training and continuous improvement of the parsing team on new document types, tricky edge cases, and evolving requirements
* Lead the parsing team on one\-off projects the company sends their way
* Pitch in on product operations side projects as they come up. Good exposure if you want to grow into product or ops

What We're Looking For

* Strong written and verbal communication. You'll spend a lot of your day in Slack, email, and video calls with people in different time zones
* Organized and self\-directed. This role has real independence and we need someone who can prioritize their own day
* Comfortable working with an international team. Cultural awareness, patience, and clear communication matter
* Detail\-oriented. A lot of the value here is catching the small things that are off
* Bias toward figuring things out. You'll learn our platform, our documents, and our workflows on the job

We don't require a specific degree or background. Recent grads and career\-changers are welcome to apply.

Nice to Have

* Previous experience in operations, data analysis, QA, or offshore team coordination
* Familiarity with Jira, Slack, or AI tools like Claude
* Any exposure to commercial real estate, lending, or finance

What You Get

* Full\-time W\-2, fully remote (US only)
* Real exposure to AI tools, product ops, CRE, and international team management. A solid launchpad if you want to grow into product, ops, or analyst work

How to Apply

To be considered, please complete our application at https://bit.ly/4hPBkIG. Applications submitted through Indeed alone will not be reviewed.

Pay: $25,000\.00 \- $30,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

**Site Operations Manager – Sports \& Entertainment Venue**


**Location: Northern California**  

**Salary: $120,000 annually**


**Lead the Janitorial Operations for a Professional Sports and Entertainment Venue**



Pritchard Sports \& Entertainment Group is seeking an accomplished **Site Operations Manager** to lead janitorial and housekeeping operations for a high\-profile sports and entertainment venue in Northern California.



Reporting to the District Manager, this position is responsible for the overall performance of a complex, high\-volume operation supporting games, concerts, special events, and daily facility needs. The Site Operations Manager will lead a diverse unionized workforce that may include managers, supervisors, leads, full\-time and part\-time team members, event and post\-event staff, and approved contract labor.



The successful candidate will be a visible, hands\-on leader with extensive experience managing large venue operations, building strong client relationships, developing high\-performing teams, and delivering exceptional service in a fast\-paced environment.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Venue and Event Operations**


* Plan, coordinate, and oversee all aspects of daily housekeeping, event cleaning, and post\-event cleaning operations.
* Develop comprehensive staffing and deployment plans based on event schedules, attendance projections, venue configurations, and client requirements.
* Inspect arena seating, suites, concourses, restrooms, premium areas, offices, back\-of\-house spaces, and other assigned areas to ensure operational readiness and service quality.
* Ensure cleaning services are coordinated and executed safely, efficiently, professionally, and in accordance with contractual expectations.
* Respond to client concerns with urgency, professionalism, and effective follow\-through.
* Remain accessible and highly visible during major events, operational transitions, and other critical service periods.

  


**Client and Stakeholder Partnership**


* Serve as the primary liaison between Pritchard Sports \& Entertainment Group and the venue’s management team.
* Build trusted relationships with client leaders, venue partners, third\-party vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* Participate in operational meetings, event\-planning meetings, post\-event reviews, and other internal or external meetings as needed.
* Provide timely updates regarding staffing, service delivery, safety, quality, and operational risks.
* Oversee approved subcontractors and third\-party service providers to ensure performance aligns with contractual and operational standards.


**Labor Relations and Union Workforce Management**


* Lead daily operations within a unionized work environment while maintaining productive, professional relationships with union representatives, shop stewards, employees, and venue leadership.
* Apply and administer collective bargaining agreements consistently, including provisions related to scheduling, seniority, job assignments, overtime, attendance, employee classifications, work rules, and disciplinary procedures.
* Partner closely with Human Resources and Labor Relations when addressing grievances, investigations, corrective actions, employee concerns, and contract\-interpretation matters.
* Maintain accurate documentation and ensure management decisions comply with collective bargaining agreements, company policies, and applicable labor laws.
* Train and coach managers and supervisors on effective union workforce management and consistent application of contract requirements.
* Support labor\-management meetings, grievance resolution, contract implementation, and collective bargaining preparations as needed.
* Anticipate labor\-related operational risks and develop practical solutions that protect service continuity, employee relations, and client satisfaction.


**Required Union Labor Experience**


* Substantial, hands\-on experience managing a large, unionized workforce in a complex, high\-volume operation is required.
* Demonstrated knowledge of collective bargaining agreements, grievance procedures, progressive discipline, seniority provisions, scheduling requirements, overtime rules, and union work practices.
* Proven ability to build effective working relationships with union representatives and shop stewards while maintaining management accountability and operational standards.
* Experience working in partnership with Human Resources, Labor Relations, and legal counsel on sensitive employee and labor matters.
* Union workforce experience within a major arena, stadium, convention center, entertainment venue, hospitality operation, or large\-scale janitorial environment is strongly preferred.


**Team Leadership**


* Lead, coach, and develop managers, supervisors, leads, and frontline team members.
* Plan schedules and assign work for full\-time, part\-time, event, and post\-event employees.
* Partner with Human Resources and Talent Acquisition on workforce planning, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and corrective action.
* Establish clear performance expectations and hold leaders accountable for service quality, productivity, attendance, safety, and employee engagement.
* Develop and conduct operational, equipment, service, and safety training programs.
* Foster a respectful, inclusive, and service\-focused workplace culture.


**Financial and Administrative Management**


* Develop, manage, and monitor the site’s operating budget, labor expenses, supplies, equipment, and other controllable costs.
* Maintain appropriate financial procedures, records, accounts, and internal controls.
* Track the cost of work performed and prepare cost estimates, labor reports, and event settlements as requested.
* Review payroll and labor reports for accuracy and timely submission.
* Maintain required logs, inspection reports, safety reports, staffing records, and other operational documentation.

**Real Estate Project Manager**

**Location:** Sunnyvale / Santa Clara County, CA — Hybrid Preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Compensation:** $85,000–$100,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications

**About The Shee Group**

The Shee Group is a residential real estate team serving Silicon Valley and surrounding communities. We are committed to providing exceptional service, strong communication, and a seamless experience for our clients throughout the buying and selling process.

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and owner\-minded **Real Estate Project Manager** to oversee listing preparation, transaction support, client communication, vendor coordination, and day\-to\-day operational projects.

**Position Overview**

The Real Estate Project Manager serves as a central point of coordination between clients, agents, vendors, transaction coordinators, and internal team members. This person is responsible for taking ownership of projects from start to finish and ensuring that listings, transactions, and operational priorities move forward smoothly, efficiently, and on schedule.

This role requires someone who can work **independently with minimal supervision**. The successful candidate will be expected to identify what needs to happen next, anticipate potential issues, develop solutions, and take appropriate action without waiting for step\-by\-step direction.

The ideal candidate has strong judgment, thinks several steps ahead, follows through consistently, and knows when to make decisions independently and when leadership approval is necessary.

Real estate experience is preferred, but we also welcome experienced candidates from project management, operations, executive support, customer success, hospitality, or other fast\-paced, client\-facing industries.

* Obtain and review proposals and bids and coordinate necessary approvals.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering and 10 years of relevant experience
* 2 years of successful management of engineering projects

* Leading a team on mid\-sized and/or moderately complex projects inside and outside of HNTB using sub\-consultants.
* Using system tools to manage, monitor, and deliver mid\-sized and/or moderately complex projects.
* Leading with minimal assistance from the Office Management Team in implementing HNTB Sophisticated processes as applicable to the project.
* Serving as the lead interface with the client on moderately complex projects.
* Developing successors to work with same client on other work.

* 12 years relevant experience
* Professional Engineer (PE) certification

Just as our customers find value in Apple products, the Finance group finds value for both Apple and its shareholders. As part of this group, you'll play an integral role in ensuring our day\-to\-day financial health. You and your team will support Apple's growth, both top and bottom line, by applying the same level of innovation toward financial matters as we do toward our products and services. You'll also collaborate with Apple teams across the world to develop more effective investment strategies and risk management. Finance is essential to upholding our global commitment to perfection, and it is directly responsible for shaping the company's future. Join us, and you'll have an important role in continuing Apple's legacy of efficiency and success.  

  

We are seeking an experienced and technically strong Program Manager to drive Services Finance transformation initiatives, modernizing and optimizing the systems, workflows, and controls that power Apple's ecosystem, including Ads, App Store, Maps, Music, TV, and WPC. This role works hand\-in\-hand with Services Finance, IS\&T, Services Engineering, and SME’s within the broader finance organization. The ideal candidate is a naturally technical operator, and a classic document\-driven program manager, who can organize engineering work into coherent, deliverable capabilities.  

  

**Description**  

  

The Senior Program Manager will develop and articulate a clear vision and roadmap for transforming Services Finance processes, systems, and workflows. This role is grounded first in Services domain expertise, executed through hands\-on technical program management, and enabled by direct fluency in data and systems.  

  

","responsibilities":"Own the program plan, timeline, and cross\-functional coordination for transformation initiatives, in close collaboration with Finance, Services, and IS\&T leadership.  

  

Collaborate with Services Business teams, Finance, and IS\&T to design next\-generation financial systems that support ongoing business evolution.  

  

Develop a programmatic strategy for Apple’s financial system architecture to facilitate business expansion through robust financial accounting automation, internal controls, and strategic alignment.  

  

Evaluate, recommend, and oversee implementation of new enterprise technologies and systems using direct technical fluency to validate solutions in close partnership with IS\&T.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Advanced knowledge of subscription finance ecosystems, including billing, revenue recognition, and financial reporting across various service business models  

  

Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex and technical cross\-functional projects, influence stakeholders, and drive change across IS\&T, PMO, and business units  

  

General knowledge of core GBS processes (Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Record to Report)  

  

Hands\-on experience with systems supporting subscription and services finance, including defining initial requirements and developing system designs.  

  

Proven ability to apply emerging technologies (Generative AI, RPA) to Services Finance problems such as revenue recognition anomaly detection, subscription billing reconciliation, and automated compliance monitoring, from concept through implementation.  

  

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance and internal\-controls frameworks relevant to service subscriptions and finance operations.  

  

Demonstrated expertise in the architectural design and implementation of Financial Systems and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions.  

  

Experience distilling complex technical work and system architecture designs into clear, business\-relevant presentations for senior management and executive audiences.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

7\-10 years of progressive experience in program management, finance operations, systems analysis, or process transformation, with demonstrated success owning significant technical workstreams end\-to\-end.  

  

BS or BA in Business, Economics, or equivalent.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $207,400 and $311,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver and project manager who loves systems, data, stewarding donor relationships, and supporting the arts.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

*Gift Processing and Acknowledgments**:*

* Track donations, including gifts from DAFs, IRAs, stock, and in\-kind partners, and patron data using Tessitura customer relationship management (CRM) software with efficiency and accuracy.

* Track and produce monthly pledge reminder letters and charge ongoing pledge and recurring payments.
* Assist with special events\-related data entry and acknowledgements.

*Reporting and Analysis**:*

* Provide ongoing financial reporting and analysis.
* Regularly partner with Finance to perform financial reconciliations.
* Support the Development department’s reporting and analysis needs: generate reports, pull lists for events and mailings, and build reporting dashboards in Tessitura Analytics.
* Ensure accurate tracking of fundraising appeal results and lead in\-depth reporting and analysis for annual fund campaigns.
* Provide through analysis of past results, identify and pull data for target lead groups for email and direct mail appeals.

*Data Management**:*

* Ensure efficient fundraising operations using Tessitura CRM software and other tools, including streamlined and accurate gift processing, gift acknowledgment, and donor/funder recognition.
* Evaluate development data management processes and recommend improvements as needed to streamline efficiency and ensure accuracy.
* Maintain donor and gift data integrity, including regular data management, duplicate donor record merging, and record clean\-up according to Berkeley Rep data standards.

*Training and Documentation**:*

* Serve as a Tessitura super user, participating in Berkeley Rep’s Tessitura User Group, and serve as a Tessitura resource for the Development department; lead Tessitura upgrades testing and training for the Development department.
* Manage the team’s Tessitura “wish list” and coordinate with Operations staff and third\-party contractors to ensure those needs are met.
* Train Development staff on most current operational systems, processes, and protocols, particularly in efficient gift processing, reporting, and analytics.
* Update and maintain development operations documentation.

*General Administrative and Event Support:*

* Engage with patrons and donors in person and by email and phone, in a prompt, courteous, and friendly manner.
* Handle department filing and office supply ordering.
* Assist with donor research and benefits fulfillment, as needed.
* Assist with supporting and staffing Berkeley Rep’s annual fundraising gala and donor events.
* Actively participate in workshops and trainings, including company meetings, harassment prevention, bystander intervention, and all other antiracism, equity, diversity, inclusion, and access initiatives.
* Demonstrate a high degree of coachability and ability to integrate feedback into daily workflows and processes.
* All other projects and duties, as assigned.

* Two years of professional experience or combination of academic and professional experience in customer or donor relationship management, data entry, or administrative support.
* Proficiency with MS Office, including Excel.

new_jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician
new_jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.


As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------



With direction from the QA Inspection Supervisor(s) and Quality Management perform dimensional inspections on machined and molded components manufactured from internal and external sources per engineering drawings and applicable external standards. Maintains inspection equipment including Vertex and Vectors. Also maintains control of products on hold.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------



Perform first article and final product inspections working from engineering drawings, procedures, and external standards, using typical inspection equipment such as micrometers, thread gauges, calipers, optical comparator, concentricity gauge, and height \& depth gages.


Perform receiving inspection of Finished Goods and components using typical inspection equipment.


Perform component testing utilizing various inspection equipment such as tensile testers, force gages and custom equipment.


Complete and maintain all QA paperwork in accordance with established procedures and manufacturing practices including the generation of receiving and inspection records, first article reports, discrepant material reports, QA history log sheets, and document change requests (DCR’s) as required. Ensure all handwritten documentation is clear and legible.


Support the qualification/validation of new products/process projects; perform specialized inspections to help engineering develop new products, gages, and inspection methods.


Follow written procedures and engineering specifications utilized for inspection and ensure documents are kept current and adequate for the inspections performed. Provide feedback to QA Management on documents requiring updates or error correction.


Interact with personnel from departments outside of the Quality Inspection department, i.e. Manufacturing, Materials, Engineering, etc, to improve on overall Quality of product entering into the QA Inspection department.


Generate Non\-conformance Reports for submitted product found out of specification. Coordinates movement/control/disposition of products that are under investigation for non\- conformance. Coordinate shipment of Finished Goods scrap for destruction. Generate Quality Hold documents and coordinate containment of affected product.


Publish various daily quality related reports.


Perform additional duties as assigned by supervisor.


Using typical MS Office software (Word, Excel, and Outlook) create and perform simple data entry tasks and procedure changes as requested by QA Management.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------



Ability to use typical measuring devices (micrometer, caliper, comparator, thread gages, go/nogo gages and custom gages) and test instruments (pull and torque testers).


Experience in medical device manufacturing and / or clean room is a plus.


Working knowledge of sampling techniques (e.g., ANSI Z1\.4\.), Good Manufacturing Practices and other regulatory standards required.


Ability to read standard operating procedures engineering drawings; Ability to lift boxes less than 50 lbs


Attention to detail


Ability to work independently


Good organizational and communication skills

**Your Background**
-------------------



High school Diploma or GED required.


Minimum of 5 years applicable experience required.


Work experience in an ISO and/or regulated industry environment preferred

**Physical Requirements**
-------------------------


**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------



None

new_jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician 1
new_jobs.description:
**Forming Our Future together**


FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de\-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.


Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership \& Accountability, Respectfully \& Effectively Communicate, and Motivate \& Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

**Shift:**


The regular hours for this position are Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and every other Saturday from 6:00pm to 6:15am. You will receive a 15% shift differential for working on the night shift.**Job Description:**


The **Quality Assurance Technician 1** is responsible for performing detailed inspections and quality control activities to ensure products meet internal standards and customer specifications. This role requires strong technical inspection skills, proficiency with microscopes and measurement tools, and the ability to collaborate with engineering and operations teams. The Technician will support both in‑process and final inspection workflows in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Inspection \& Quality Control**

* Perform detailed defect inspections of advanced probing technology products using the **Olympus MX‑50 microscope** and other precision inspection tools.
* Conduct **in‑process inspections** to verify product quality during various manufacturing stages.
* Complete **finished goods inspections** to ensure all outgoing material meets customer and internal specifications.
* Capture and document high\-quality **inspection images** of components and products.

**Nonconformance Management**

* Identify nonconforming product and generate accurate, timely **nonconformance reports**.
* Partner with engineering teams to support investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions related to quality issues.

**Data \& Documentation**

* Validate outgoing product data to ensure compliance with customer requirements.
* Perform accurate **data entry** and maintain up\-to\-date inventory information in the appropriate database systems.
* Follow detailed work instructions, SOPs, and documentation standards to maintain product traceability and compliance.

**Teamwork \& Operational Support**

* Work within a shift\-based team environment to support daily quality, engineering, and production activities.
* Contribute both as a collaborative team member and as an individual contributor to help meet daily inspection and production quotas.
* Follow a **compressed work schedule (3x4\)** as assigned.

**Work Environment \& Physical Requirements:**

* Role may involve frequent standing, repetitive hand motions, and handling small or delicate components.
* Work performed primarily in a clean‑room manufacturing setting, requiring adherence to gowning and contamination‑control procedures.
* May require exposure to chemicals, specialty tools, microscopes, or precision measurement equipment.
* Must follow all required safety protocols, wear appropriate PPE and clean‑room attire (full coverall suit, hairnet, mask, gloves, etc.) for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs.

**Skills:**

Clean Room Manufacturing, Communication, Computer Literacy, Data Entry, Hand Dexterity, Microscope, Microsoft Office, Problem Solving, Working Independently**Education \& Experience:**

Less than 1 year of related experience. No formal occupational training is typically required \| Required**Pay Range:**


$19\.30 \- $25\.36**Pay Range Explained:**


This role in Livermore, California pays between $19\.30 and $25\.36 per hour, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You’ll also be eligible for quarterly profit\-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts.**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**


FormFactor is an equal opportunity employer. FormFactor complies with all national, state, and local laws that seek to promote equal opportunities for any applicant or employee without regard to age, race, color, gender, gender identity/expression, national origin, sexual orientation, religion, disability, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, military service, or any other legally protected characteristics. These protections apply to all aspects of employment, including but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotions, and compensation.

  

For roles that are designated as remote\-eligible, employees cannot be located in: AL, AK, AR, DE, GA, HI, IL, IA, LA, ME, MD, MS, MO, NE, NV, NJ, NM, ND, OK, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, WV, WI, WY. This list is continuously evolving and being updated, please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. A role is remote\-eligible only when it is listed as "Remote" in the job location.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager III, Hardware NPI, Cloud Supply Chain
new_jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience driving New Product Introduction (NPI) for hardware programs (e.g., PCBA, accelerators, equipment, racks, switches, optics).
* Experience with materials management (e.g., bill of materials (BOMs), contract manufacturers, supplier coordination, delivery material readiness, etc.).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Hardware supply chain experience driving products from prototype to mass production.
* Experience with supply planning and accounting/finance analytics.
* Ability to collaborate and influence across multiple levels of an organization and experience leading cross functional process improvements, using strong analytical and communication/facilitation skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


As Program Manager, you will lead all aspects of supply chain readiness in New Product Introduction (NPI) products for our global data centers. You will work with cross\-functional teams starting with product inception to volume ramp to bring innovative products into global data centers efficiently and dynamically. You will demonstrate domain expertise in material readiness, clear to build, supplier and contract manufacturer management, procurement, manufacturing, supply resiliency, and are well versed in other aspects of operations and engineering that impact supply chain strategies and execution.  

  

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing materials plans, enabling prototype builds and driving production ramp plans for products deployed in our data centers. Product types include networking, infrastructure, and server and storage. You will work closely with Engineering, Supply Chain Operations, Supply and Demand Planning, Contract Manufacturing, and Supplier partners to launch new products and to implement processes and systems that directly scale new product deployments.


Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive material and supply chain readiness for all NPI builds from concept phase to production handoff, partnering with cross\-functional teams to ensure success.
* Identify and communicate supply chain risks and mitigation plans to ensure materials readiness for NPI builds as well as enabling long term supply continuity into production.
* Be the primary materials liaison with ODM/CM/Suppliers, manage spend against project budgets, and drive large production risk buys and strategic buffers.
* Develop and document global supply chain map for each product, including suppliers, procurement model, lead time, shipment logistics, assembly/test/fulfillment model, and spares strategies.
* Update project schedules, communicate status, risks and influence change, and represent the New Product Introduction Supply Chain organization in internal program meetings, driving initiatives and process improvements to help the team grow in scalability.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

new_jobs.title: Differential Response Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**AGENCY DESCRIPTION:**

Instituto Familiar de la Raza, Inc. is a multi\-service community health \& social service agency with emphasis in serving the Chicano/Latino/Indigenous community in San Francisco with a special focus on the diverse needs of the Mission District. Services include a wide range of mental health, HIV related services, and social services including health promotion, education, prevention, early intervention, case management, clinical, psychological and psychiatric interventions as well as cultural/social and spiritual re\-enforcement. The agency serves children, youth, adults \& families; it has a rich history of working collaboratively with other agencies to meet the needs of the diverse Chicano/Latino/Indigenous communities, \& other cultural/racial communities in San Francisco.

**JOB/ PROGRAM DESCRIPTION:**

The Chicano/Latino Family Resource system (FRS) is a collaborative project of four community agencies. The project’s purpose is to combine the efforts and staff of the collaborating agencies to develop prevention, early intervention, and intensive case management programs and services which reinforce family preservation with high\-risk families residing in the Mission District and Chicano/Latino families throughout San Francisco.

The Differential Response (DR) program within FRS, works with fifteen partnered community agencies throughout San Francisco and with the Human Services Agency (HSA) to provide services to families referred to CPS and in need of additional support to prevent out of home placement and re\-referrals. This position supervises the Data and Training Specialist, as part of the Differential Response Team. Essential Job Duties are but not limited to the following:

*Program Leadership*

* Coordinate citywide Differential Response (DR) services by serving as the primary point of contact for HSA, FCS, and DEC, uplifting communication and effective service delivery
* Serve as a liaison with HSA and partner agencies by maintaining consistent communication on referrals, service outcomes, and program updates
* Support the ongoing implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of DR program procedures
* Lead implementation of the Family First Prevention Services Act (FFPSA) requirements as they relate to the DR program, ensuring compliance
* Develop and maintain annual schedules for DR\-related meetings, training, and site visits
* Support organizational and programmatic goals by participating in special projects, community events, and other related duties
* Provide leadership to DR Liaisons through consultation, coaching, and technical assistance
* Provide consultation and technical assistance to DR Liaisons and HSA staff citywide, strengthening capacity to respond effectively to family needs.
* Facilitate bi\-monthly DR Liaison meetings to foster collaboration, share resources, and promote alignment across agencies.

*Collaboration, Partnerships \& Communication*

* Lead and facilitate monthly DR Coordination Team meetings, Workgroup meetings, and Case Consultation sessions with CBO partners and HSA staff
* Collaborate with FCS Protective Service Workers, supervisors, and other representatives to determine the best fit for family needs (Red Team Meeting)
* Facilitate bi\-monthly DR Liaison meetings to foster collaboration, share resources, and promote alignment across agencies. (also relevant to capacity building)

*Referral Management \& Service Coordination*

* Triage and assign DR and SafeCare referrals received from HSA to appropriate partner agencies, ensuring timely and equitable service connection for families across the city, ensuring 95% of referrals are responded to within 2 working days

*Quality Assurance, Compliance \& Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI)*

* Conduct quarterly site visits and case chart reviews to ensure compliance with Standards of Quality for Family Strengthening and Support (SQFSS)
* Conduct quarterly quality assurance reviews of partner agencies, assessing compliance, program fidelity, and overall effectiveness of service delivery
* Develop progress reports and include outcomes in quarterly reports, framed in a CQI methodology

*Data Management, Evaluation \& Reporting*

* Prepare and manage Differential Response data collection, entry, and reporting across multiple platforms including FFPSA Master Tracker, CMS Carbon Report, statistical summaries, and quarterly progress reports to meet contractual and collaborative requirements.

**Required Skills:**

* Minimum of three years’ experience providing social services
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Access, Word, and Power Point and utilizing email communication ∙ Excellent written and oral skills in English
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks and organizational skills
* Knowledge and sensitivity to issues of diversity including that of gender, race, language, sexual orientation and socio\-economic status
* Proven ability to communicate effectively under high stress situations; demonstrated diplomacy and sensitivity with clients under stress

**Preferred Skills:**

* Bilingual Spanish/English
* Advanced Excel skills (including Power Query) and familiarity with Microsoft 365 tool
* Knowledge and experience with the San Francisco FRC initiative
* Experience in a non\-profit community agency

**EDUCATION, CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES:**

* Bachelor of Arts degree in Social Work or related field
* Complete annual recurrent DPH online training
* Must pass and maintain annual Tuberculosis Test
* Must pass Department of Justice Fingerprint screening

* Good general health, physical stamina and emotional stability are essential
* Ability to hear within normal range, and communicate effec

new_jobs.title: Orientation and Onboarding Program Manager - HR
new_jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate Orientation and Onboarding Program Manager to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of new hire orientation experiences in our NALA region for the United States, Canada, Brazil, and Mexico. In this role, you will be the architect of a new hire's first impression of our company by creating engaging, inclusive, and informative orientation programs that connect employees to our culture, values, and mission from the start.

 **What you'll be doing:**

* Orientation Program Ownership: Design, manage, and continuously evolve a world\-class new hire orientation program, including in\-person, virtual, and hybrid formats.
* Cultural Integration: Champion our company culture and values through immersive onboarding experiences that resonate across diverse geographies and backgrounds.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Collaborate with HR, Communications, IT, Legal, Real Estate and Site Services (RESS), and many other groups to curate and deliver a seamless, end\-to\-end orientation experience.
* Content Creation \& Curation: Develop and maintain engaging orientation materials including presentations, welcome videos, new hire task lists, and digital resources.
* Facilitation \& Hosting: Serve as a primary facilitator and host for orientation sessions, creating an energetic and welcoming environment for new hires.
* Speaker \& Executive Coordination: Recruit, prepare, and schedule executive speakers and cross\-functional presenters to participate in orientation programming.
* Technology \& Platforms: Manage orientation delivery platforms and tools to ensure a consistent and accessible experience for all new hires.
* Continuous Onboarding: Manage and develop continuous onboarding programs post\-orientation. This may include New Hire Office Hours, Socials, Volunteer Events and much more.
* Metrics \& Feedback: Review our Listening PM's key metrics and leverage insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Budget Management: Oversee the orientation program budget, ensuring resources are allocated effectively.
* Any other project work or job duties, as assigned.

 **What we need to see:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of experience in HR program management, employee experience, or learning \& development, with a strong focus on orientation or onboarding programs.
* Exceptional facilitation, presentation, and public speaking skills with the ability to engage audiences of varying sizes and backgrounds.
* Strong project management and organizational skills; capable of managing multiple priorities across time zones.
* Strong business insight and understanding of cross\-functional work.
* Ability to develop strong partnering relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Working knowledge of HR law and practices.
* Customer focused while being responsive with a sense of urgency as well as the ability to lead projects to successful completion, multi\-task, and work within tight deadlines.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills: concise, articulate, confident as well as the ability to communicate and negotiate effectively with all levels of associates and management.
* Ability to work productively and collaboratively with team members and provide extraordinary customer service as well as be flexible and able to quickly adjust to new priorities.
* Ability to work onsite at the Santa Clara campus.

 **Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* SHRM\-CP, PHR, or PMP certification.
* Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams.
* Familiarity with e\-learning tools such as Articulate 360\.
* Background with immigration, relocation, and HR compliance.
* Experience with global orientation and onboarding.


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 104,000 USD \- 166,750 USD.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.


Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 2, 2026\.
This posting is for an existing vacancy.

====================================

  

**Date:** Sep 28, 2026


**Location:** San Jose, California, United States


**Company:** Super Micro Computer


**Job Req ID: 30378**
---------------------


**About Supermicro:**
---------------------


Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. ----------------


We are seeking a Sr. Supply Chaing Program Manager with 10\+ years of experience in AI server or HPC hardware manufacturing and strong project management expertise. new_jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

**The Role**
------------


Reporting to the Director, Account Management \- Enterprise, you'll partner with our Enterprise Client Success Management partners to ensure our employer partners see value in the Handshake product in order to retain and grow a key segment of our business.
  

  

We’re looking for an Enterprise Account Manager to join our Employer Sales Team \- working with top employers across the nation to drive their early talent recruiting strategy. You will serve as the primary owner of a set book of existing employer partners, working closely with them to ensure they achieve their goals, build relationships with executives, and drive customer retention and expansion from onboarding through renewal.


This high\-impact role combines equal parts sales, relationship management and customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate has a proven record managing relationships at scale while driving renewals and expansions in a *Saas* technology company.

* Effectively renew, upsell and cross\-sell an assigned book of business of existing premium employer partners with an emphasis on growth
* Learn your book of business inside and out to effectively position Handshake’s value proposition, always linking it back to key business issues of the customer
* Develop and cultivate deep relationships with senior executives at the Director, SVP, VP, and C\-suite levels at our partners
* Develop new and creative ways to engage senior executives throughout the customer lifecycle and demonstrate Handshake’s value
* Partner closely with our Employer Customer Success Team to ensure customers adopt and are successful on Handshake
* Manage and present data and value\-driven Quarterly Business Reviews
* Enlist and inspire customers to participate in Handshake events and other marketing materials
* Manage overall customer loyalty, serving as internal advocate and escalation point to customers
* Assist in identifying and developing scalable account management tools and methodologies that can be applied across the Account Management team  

Help scale internal process to support hundreds of premium employers
* Becoming a Handshake expert, learning the ins and outs of HR and higher ed Tech

 *Must be willing to work onsite from our SF or NY office\- expected 5 days a week.*  

*Must be willing to travel as needed for customer engagements.*

**You Have**
------------

* At least 2\+ years of sales experience in Enterprise SaaS sales or Account Management, 5\+ years in a closing and quota carrying role
* Experience preparing renewal proposals, forecasting, and account planning
* A strong history of quota attainment and excellent performance on a high\-reaching team  

Experience with an evangelical sale, selling non\-discretionary software to executives at Fortune 1000 companies
* Experience managing customer relationships alongside a Customer Success team
* Experience using usage, data and results to demonstrate value and justify expansion
* An impeccable communicator with polished and professional sales presentation skills
* Experience operating in a high\-growth business environment like Handshake

**We Offer**
------------


Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported and thrive at work and in life.

***The below benefits are for full\-time US employees.***


**Ownership:** Equity in a fast\-growing company


**Financial Wellness**: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching


**Family Support:** Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching


**Wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend


**Growth:** $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development


**Remote \& Office:** Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office


**Time Off:** Flexible PTO, 15 holidays \+ 2 flex days


**Connection:** Team outings \& referral bonuses


Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers.


Compensation Range: $179\.2K \- $224K

Workplace Resources (WPR) is looking for a dynamic Service Delivery Manager (Technical Services) for the Americas West Portfolio. This role would be based and report out of our San Jose campus. The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in technical facilities, engineering, or technical project management, with experience leading complex technical services and driving operational excellence. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced technical leader looking to take the next step in their career.
  
  

**What You’ll Do:**  

* Govern an FM Contract which ensures all Americas West locations have a maintenance, life cycle management strategy\& engineering plan for technical assets (HVAC, Building Management Systems, etc.)
* You will partner with the worldwide team, and local leaders to deploy existing Cisco policies and procedures using your industry expertise and knowledge, ensuring owned and leased workplaces are safe\& functional.
* Establish business relationships to better align current services today and ensure complete support of the business units as they constantly evolve and innovate.


The delivery of FM Hard services via outsourced Service Providers including:
  
  

* Contractual execution against existing critical metrics and SLAs
* Strategic Asset Opex\& CAPEX Investment Plans, including due diligence, developing multi\-year programs, prioritize work into projects, present/align the plan for the project teams to deliver.
* Driving continuous improvements in service levels, operating costs, energy\& sustainability, quality and safety.
* Monitoring and Reporting on significant events impacting business operations.
* Budget\& Spend Management, and prioritizing needs. Contract Variations, Work Order\& Financial Approvals.
* Owning Business Continuity plans associated to FM Hard Services


Who You’ll Work With
  
Reports to Americas Workplace Services Leader. The WPR Delivery team provides local focus and relevance in various geographic regions including all real estate transactions, capital investment program management and facility maintenance, operation, EHS, and procurement. We partner with suppliers to ensure quality, innovation and scalability with Cisco's business and apply customer\-driven feedback to continuously improve and exceed client and employee expectations.
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelors in an engineering discipline, plus 5\-10 years of facility management or related proven experience
* Proven experience leading facilities service delivery and performance management, including managing operational performance, SLAs/KPIs, risk, and service outcomes across complex environments.
* Strong technical knowledge of building systems and critical infrastructure, with the ability to understand and translate complex technical concepts for senior leaders and cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrated program/project management experience, including developing business requirements, building business cases, driving stakeholder alignment, and delivering complex initiatives from planning through implementation.
* Competent in financial analysis, budget management and modelling, large scale asset capital planning and feasibility studies.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience managing large, complex, multi\-site facilities portfolios.
* Experience in 24x7 data centers, R labs, network labs, or other critical infrastructure environments.
* Knowledge of MEP systems, HVAC, BMS/building controls, asset maintenance, and critical infrastructure.
* Experience with asset management, procurement, lifecycle management, equipment costing, and total cost of ownership.
* Experience with environmental compliance, sustainability, and renewable energy programs.
* Experience developing and executing asset management and procurement strategies.
* Professional certifications in engineering, facilities management, project/program management, or related disciplines.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

new_jobs.title: Seasonal Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
**Location:** Walnut Creek, California
We inspire purpose\-filled living that brings beauty and quality to the modern home. Together, we achieve. Associates across our business drive results, innovate, and inspire. Drawn together by our shared values and passion for our customers and our brands, we deliver home furnishings that are expertly designed, responsibly sourced, and bring timeless style and function to people’s homes. From the day we opened our first store in Chicago in 1962 to the digital innovations that engage millions of customers today, our iconic brand is over 60 years in the making—and our story is still unfolding.



We’re here for it. We think ***you should be too.***


Our Seasonal Operations Associates are at the core of our customers’ experience. Friendly, outgoing and naturally driven, they are enthusiastic brand ambassadors who tend to love our amazing associate discount! A fan of all things home, their enthusiasm brings a level of excitement to our stores that makes shopping fun, engaging and keeps customers coming back. With leadership and mentoring support from your leader, Operations Associates ensure our shelves are filled, our displays are complete and our stock room stays prepped and “at the ready” to fulfill customer orders in our stores. The heartbeat of a store’s operation, these roles are largely behind the scenes but help us deliver exceptional customer service and drive sales. We’d love to talk to you about how a seasonal position with CBH could be a fun and flexible holiday opportunity as part of a diverse and innovative team.
**A day in the life as a Seasonal Operations Associate...**

* Perform prompt and accurate stock checks, while maintaining an organized and efficient stockroom.
* Assist the leadership team with ensuring product and displays on the sales floor are stocked appropriately and available for customers to purchase.
* Process incoming and outgoing packages, including customer curbside pick\-up orders, ship from store, and buy online, pick up in store, in a timely manner.
* Support and maintain store sales and service goals and standards as communicated by the leadership team.
* Drive sales through engagement of customers, sharing and demonstrating product knowledge and product expertise, as needed.
* Lead by example and support store leadership in holding self and others accountable for store profitability and operational excellence.
* Have awareness of current promotions, brand initiatives/events, store services, collaborations, and promote them to customers.
* Maintain an awareness of loss prevention, security and safety following the guidelines provided by leadership and/or as outlined in the Associate Policy Manual.
* Promote a strong sense of teamwork by working together safely, effectively, respectfully and efficiently with all associates.

**What you'll bring to the table...**

* Customer service or retail experience preferred
* Good communication skills
* Ability to move and/ or lift up to 50 pounds; heavier merchandise with team assist
* Must be able to work the weekend after Thanksgiving AND the days surrounding Christmas
* Part\-Time roles: Availability to work two or more weekend days (Friday, Saturday, and/or Sunday) and at least one weekday or night

  

  

**Starting Rate:** $18\.00 \- $22\.50
Pay ranges will be adjusted upward as needed to comply with applicable state and local law. In addition to your salary, based on your role, associates may be eligible for other compensation including bonuses, sales incentives, and long term incentives.

new_jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data\-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.


But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020\. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin\-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward\-thinking, innovative force in the market.


Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting\-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

* Advise customers on platform enhancements, integrations, and upgrades — ensuring alignment with the Strategy product roadmap and the customer's long\-term data strategy.

* Support the successful renewal and expansion of customer accounts by ensuring continuous technical and business value realization from the Strategy platform.

* Proactively identify renewal risks and collaborate with Sales and leadership on mitigation plans before they escalate.
* Develop strong referenceable customers willing to participate in case studies, testimonials, reference calls, and industry events.

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience) required.
