new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.description:
**PIVOT INTERIORS**



Our organization includes a strategic team of big thinkers and creatives who truly work interdependently. Whether planning our Customer Experience program, developing multi\-pronged marketing strategies, or designing projects for our innovative clients, we are constantly finding ways to underscore our promise to partner with our clients to make inspiring spaces that unlock their people’s greatest potential. The pace is fast, the learning is constant…but as part of a team this driven, the possibilities are endless.


**Your Role at Pivot**



As Operations Coordinator 1, you will be responsible for all Service Operations work\-order transfers into the Company’s scheduling software and for soft scheduling orders and projects. You will ensure orders are ready to dispatch and report blockers and work with team to ensure success of dispatch. The work you do is highly nuanced and requires a strong attention to detail with ability to effectively coordinate and communicate between a multitude of internal parties.


**In Addition, You Will**


* Transfer work orders in order of importance, “soft” schedule the work, notify relevant stakeholders via business systems, and enter all corresponding work order details and documents within 8 hours of receipt.
* Review all project particulars including labor PO, hours, etc. prior to scheduling ensuring the project will be executed correctly. Follow up with internal departments for missing project details as needed.
* Collaborate as necessary with key stakeholders to ensure the project succeeds.
* Print all required paperwork for installation staff including work orders, prints, and field paperwork.
* Create product pull lists for the warehouse staff and Receiving Coordinator.
* Perform other duties or special projects assigned.


**We’re Excited About You If You Have**


* A high school diploma or GED and up to 1\-2 years of related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Knowledge of commonly used concepts, practices, and procedures within field. Rely on instructions and pre\-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job.
* Operations database experience, previous working experience with Microsoft Word, Excel and experience creating and saving PDFs.
* High attention to detail along with strong organization skills.
* An established understanding of the sequencing of operations required to execute projects.
* Ability to efficiently multi\-task, continuous follow through methodology, keen ability to research and learn new things, excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**



This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities.

Ability to read, speak and write in English. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports and business correspondence. Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, proportions, percentages, area, and circumference. Ability to reconcile project costs comparing original budget versus actual. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.


**REASONING ABILITY**



Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form, and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.


**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS**



None.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk, or hear, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, and operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and telephone handset and dial. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. new_jobs.title: Sales Enablement Lead
new_jobs.description:
Stuut is transforming how B2B companies turn revenue into cash. Businesses worldwide have trillions tied up in receivables, yet the work between order and payment still relies on fragmented systems and labor\-intensive manual processes. Stuut’s AI agent works across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, carrying context through every step. Customers reduce DSO by 47%, collect 40% more cash and eliminate 70% of manual work without replacing their ERP.  

  

Stuut is already trusted by finance teams at companies including Honeywell, NCR and ZoomInfo, from Fortune 10 enterprises to scaling mid\-market businesses. We are backed by a16z, Khosla Ventures, Activant, 1984 Ventures, Page One and Microsoft.

**The Role**
------------

Stuut is seeking its first Sales Enablement hire to build the function for our Account Executive and BDR teams. Our sales org is growing quickly and selling a product that rapidly evolves to finance buyers. This role owns how sellers ramp, how they tell the Stuut’s story, and how they get better every quarter.


This is an individual contributor role reporting into Revenue Operations. It is hands\-on: you will set the strategy and also write the onboarding curriculum, record the demo, build the battlecard, and run call reviews. You will partner closely with Sales leadership, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Finance.

**What you'll do**
------------------


Onboarding and ramp

* Design and run a repeatable onboarding program for new BDRs, andAEs, with a defined bar for what "ramped" means at each role and clear ramp\-time targets
* Own the first 30/60/90 for every new seller, including product certification, pitch and demo certification, tooling proficiency, and territory readiness
* Build in feedback loops so every cohort improves the next one


Messaging, pitch, and demo

* Codify the Stuut pitch into a single, current, opinionated narrative that every seller can deliver the same way
* Build and maintain the standard demo flow for each product surface and keep it current as the product ships
* Partner with Product Marketing on positioning, use cases, buyer personas, and vertical narratives


Ongoing enablement and coaching

* Run a regular enablement cadence (weekly rep\-facing sessions, monthly deep dives, quarterly kickoffs) driven by what the field actually needs
* Build a live call\-review and coaching program with Sales leadership, using recorded calls to reinforce what good looks like and surface where reps are getting stuck
* Own the enablement content library — playbooks, talk tracks, discovery questions, objection handles, competitive battlecards, ROI framing — and keep it usable, current, and findable


Product\-to\-field translation

* Sit close to Product to translate each release into "what this means for the field": what to say, who to say it to, when to bring it up, and what proof to lean on
* Build a launch process that turns product updates into field readiness quickly and consistently


Sales methodology and skill development

* Partner with Sales leadership to select and operationalize the qualification and deal\-management framework that fits Stuut's motion — training, reinforcement, coaching, and inspection
* Build role\-specific skill programs (discovery, multi\-threading, negotiation, executive presence, technical selling to CFOs)


Measurement and iteration

* Define what enablement is accountable for: ramp time to first deal, pitch and demo certification pass rates, win rate on contested deals, content adoption, and manager coaching consistency
* Report against those metrics and kill programs that do not move them

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 6\+ years in sales enablement, sales training, sales operations, or a quota\-carrying / sales\-adjacent role at a B2B software company, with clear ownership of a program you built end to end
* A track record of building or scaling enablement from zero or near\-zero — you have been the first or second enablement hire before, or you have owned a function that ran like one
* Strong instincts for sales messaging and translating a complex, fast\-moving technical product into a story that sellers can tell and buyers can act on
* Fluency running coaching and call reviews with sellers and Sales leadership — you can spot what a rep needs from listening to five minutes of a call
* Ability to work cross\-functionally with Sales leadership, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Finance
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* Willingness to be in the San Francisco or New York office four days per week

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a Series A–D company selling a fast\-changing product to a mix of technical and business buyers
* Background enabling direct sales with an enterprise motion
* Experience selling or enabling into AI, finance, or accountanting
* Familiarity with modern enablement and revenue tooling (CRM, LMS, conversation intelligence, content management)
* Previous time as an AE, SDR, or SC before moving into enablement

**Compensation**

* Top\-of\-market salary and equity package
* Benefits (for U.S.\-based full\-time employees)
* Medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you
* 401(k) \& Match
* Equity
* Flexible PTO
* Parental Leave

new_jobs.description:
**About Us**



Hyperfine, Inc. (Nasdaq: HYPR) is the groundbreaking health technology company that has redefined brain imaging with the *Swoop**®*system—the first FDA\-cleared, portable, ultra\-low\-field, magnetic resonance brain imaging system capable of providing imaging at multiple points of care in a healthcare facility. Our mission is to revolutionize patient care globally through transformational, accessible, clinically relevant diagnostic imaging. Learn More


**About The Role**



Job Title**:**Clinical Support Specialist



The Clinical Support Specialist is responsible for all aspects of the initial training and support for the customer team, including physicians, nurses, radiographers, MRI Technologists, and other relevant personnel in the use of Hyperfine's Swoop Portable MRI System. This role will assist in optimizing customer experience by acting as a true consultant with regards to integrating the Swoop System within a customer's workflow and procedures. The person in this role will partner effectively to relay customer feedback to internal Hyperfine teams and will function as the clinical specialist during the product sales cycle in close collaboration with the Sales, Marketing, Clinical Science, and R\&D groups. They will also support clinical adoption, utilization, customer engagement, and related account activities for our customers.


**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Train hospital staff on the safe and effective use and operation of Hyperfine products within the clinical areas including amending workflow and optimize product value and utilization
* Provide customized training and support for new operators of the Swoop System and maintain strategic relationships and support post\-installation

* Provide R\&D with clinical input and feedback for new projects
* Support the sales team by identifying customer needs and relaying potential opportunities within the existing installed base
* Support new product evaluation and clinical studies
* Support the centers in optimizing their standard procedures and workflows

* Identify potential attrition risks and product gaps and escalate them with recommended follow\-up actions.
* Work closely with teammates and/or RN counterparts to provide customer success to install base customers and future potential customers

* MRI sequence and protocol understanding workflow optimization
* Support scanner software and firmware upgrades for customers
* Perform scanner implementations at customer sites

* Strong problem solver with sound judgment
* Hands on, strong team player, and fully accountable for delivering agreed\-upon tactical performance metrics
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Highly organized and able to multitask
* Articulate, analytical, technically savvy, and professional
* Strong computer skills
* Self\-driven and self sufficient
* Positive attitude and team player\-oriented individual
* Excellent time management, including managing daily schedule, travel plans, and expenses


**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**


* Associate's degree in Radiology Sciences or related field
* Registered Technologist with the ARRT (American Registry of Radiologic Technologists) and current credentialing in MR (Magnetic Resonance) or equivalent
* 3\+ years' experience in clinical MR imaging or similar experience such as 3\+ years X\-ray \+ 2 years in MRI in a hospital setting
* 2\+ years' experience operating in clinical applications or clinical training experience


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**


* Reside in assigned territory and ability to work from home\-based office
* Able to travel up to 75% of the time within and outside of territory, including occasional weekend travel

new_jobs.description:
**Full job description**  
Care Navigator  


**Pay: $27–$29 per hour**  


About Nurse Next Door  


Our purpose is **Making Lives Better through Happier Aging**. We help seniors stay in their homes for as long as they choose, and our real talent is caring and connecting to seniors’ hearts. We have a mission to help seniors continue doing what they love most.  


We are not just another home care company fulfilling daily tasks. We are a company that admires people and seeks to make a difference in everything we do. By working at Nurse Next Door, you will be part of a growing company that is helping seniors do what they love again.  


As a member of the Nurse Next Door team, you understand how to **hustle with heart**\—this is essential! You enjoy working collaboratively while maintaining a high degree of autonomy and thrive by seeing results. You are a self\-led leader who takes responsibility for your own actions. You show care by engaging in intentional, compassionate conversations to help others achieve their fullest potential.  


You are inspired by the idea of being involved with an organization that is changing the way we deliver home care through our **Happier Aging** philosophy.  


Position Summary  


As a **Care Designer**, you are responsible for the day\-to\-day operations related to driving business results through client experience and caregiver management. You will drive growth through the following main duties and responsibilities:  


Consult Conversion  


* Conduct Caring Consults and assess clients with respect to their physical, emotional, and environmental needs.
* Advise clients on appropriate care and achieve a **90% conversion goal**.
* Drive business interest by engaging in relationships with community leaders and professional organizations to establish long\-term relationships that translate into word\-of\-mouth and professional referrals.
* Develop, promote, and ensure high\-quality, innovative customer service.
* Act as an advisor during Caring Consults to ensure that clients and client contacts have all the information required.

Client Care Delivery and Experience  


* Attend all First Visits with caregivers to ensure client needs and care plans are executed according to the Service Agreement.
* Set and role\-model expectations for caregivers.
* Conduct supervisory visits to ensure caregiver fit and quality of care while delivering a premium client experience and impacting Net Promoter Scores of **9 or higher**.
* Develop appropriate and individualized care plans and update them as required.
* Educate clients on self\-care and evaluate client responses to care provided.
* Monitor risk issues, analyze trends, and adapt care as needed.
* Coordinate care, implement solutions, and evaluate client outcomes based on client goals.

People Leadership  


* Drive results by leading your caregiving team through clear goal\-setting, task assignment, in\-the\-moment coaching, and continuing education.
* Deliver on our Brand Promise by leading the client experience and ensuring caregivers are doing whatever it takes to bring peace of mind to our clients and their families.
* Be accountable for staff performance, ensuring caregiver availability meets business needs and that there is compliance with all systems.
* Manage the education function to support a continuous learning environment and staff utilization of learning opportunities.
* Support **Discovery Day** and monthly in\-service programs.

------------


Founded in 2021, Axion is at the forefront of transforming product quality and customer satisfaction in manufacturing. Our cutting\-edge AI\-powered platform empowers manufacturers to swiftly identify, thoroughly investigate, and effectively resolve quality issues while simultaneously elevating customer experiences and outcomes.


As trailblazers in end\-to\-end quality intelligence, we're setting new industry standards. Our innovative approach enables industrial, aerospace, consumer, and medtech manufacturers to harness the power of quality and post\-market data, driving down costs and boosting business performance.


Our vision extends beyond mere problem\-solving; we're committed to reshaping the future of manufacturing. By seamlessly integrating advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Axion is paving the way for smarter, safer, and more efficient production processes across diverse sectors.

Your first priority is making onboarding fast and repeatable while keeping the data and AI output trustworthy. You'll set the product direction for how Axion understands customer data.

* Customer and operator judgment: you can work directly with a customer and the team doing the setup, run a focused pilot, and decide how to improve the product experience from the results.
* Experience at a venture\-backed startup.

**Nice to Have**

You value feedback — giving it, receiving it, and acting on it — and you see collaboration as a competitive advantage, not a burden. You’re low\-ego but high\-agency: you care about winning as a team more than being right individually. You move quickly, communicate directly, and make decisions grounded in impact and data.


You don’t need constant direction — you create momentum. You take ownership for outcomes, and you expect the same from those around you.

The Program Manager, Compliance is a strategic driver of Stord’s operational strength and commercial growth. A mature, well\-run compliance program is not just a risk management function at Stord; it is a competitive differentiator that unlocks customer revenue, supports network expansion, and protects the business at scale.
  

  

Reporting to the Director of Health, Safety \& Security, this is an enterprise\-level, network\-wide role that operates at the intersection of compliance, operations, and growth. The Program Manager partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and Finance to ensure compliance capabilities are a strength Stord leads with \- enabling the business to pursue regulated customer segments, scale into new markets, and demonstrate the program maturity that top\-tier brands demand. The work product of this role is what the entire organization is built around: scalable written programs, audit frameworks, certification standards, reporting infrastructure, and regulatory intelligence systems that grow stronger as Stord grows.
**What This Role Owns**
=======================

This role owns the enterprise compliance program architecture \- the standards, written programs, audit frameworks, and governance mechanisms that define what ‘compliant’ looks like at every Stord facility. * Enterprise compliance reporting, data, and dashboards: building the metrics infrastructure that gives the Head of HSS, senior leadership, and the broader business real\-time visibility into compliance performance, risk posture, and program health across the network.
* Enterprise compliance training architecture: defining what training is required, for whom, at what frequency, and in what format \- building the content and governance framework that regional and site teams deliver against.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

--------------------------------------

* Build and own Stord’s enterprise OSHA compliance program \- designing the written program architecture, establishing network\-wide standards, and creating the governance mechanisms that ensure consistent compliance across every facility regardless of size, volume, or operational complexity.
* Maintain and update OSHA\-required written programs: Hazard Communication, Lockout/Tagout, Respiratory Protection, Emergency Action Plans, Powered Industrial Truck programs, and others as applicable.

Sunistics Group \| Fully remote, U.S.\-based \| $32–$40 per hour

Flexible weekday scheduling, with availability beginning no later than 7 a.m. Pacific / 10 a.m. Eastern. Weekly hours and working schedule will be agreed before hiring.

**Own the accounting operation**

Sunistics Group delivers commercial solar projects. We need a hands\-on Accounting Operations Manager who takes responsibility for accurate books, reliable payment processing and consistent follow\-through. You will organise the work, resolve issues and keep management informed without needing reminders.

You will work with our existing accounting team and external accountant. This role combines ownership of the accounting workflow with doing the work in QuickBooks Online: reconciling accounts, reviewing records, coordinating approvals and processing payments.

**What you will own**

* Keep QuickBooks Online current each week. Review bank and credit\-card activity, match transactions correctly, maintain project classifications and resolve missing or duplicate entries.
* Own the month\-end checklist and agreed close deadlines. Reconcile bank and credit\-card accounts, investigate differences and provide complete supporting records to our accountant.
* Organise vendor invoices, statements and payment requests. Confirm documentation and approval, schedule and process authorised payments, and follow through on discrepancies.
* Manage crew reimbursement requests from receipt through approval and payment. Check receipts, amounts and project details, resolve missing information and ensure each payment is recorded once.
* Manage shared accounting inboxes and scanned incoming mail. Route requests, assign follow\-up and track deadlines so important items do not get lost.
* Coordinate priorities and review work across the accounting workflow. Maintain clear procedures, identify bottlenecks and escalate issues with a concise explanation and recommended next step.
* Keep cash\-planning inputs reliable, including expected payment dates and unresolved items, while reducing duplicate entry between QuickBooks and company spreadsheets.

**AI proficiency is required**

Using artificial intelligence to improve efficiency is an expectation of this role. You must already be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Gemini or comparable tools for practical work—not simply interested in learning them later.

* Use company\-approved AI tools to simplify document handling, organise information, analyse spreadsheets, draft communications and document repeatable processes.
* Propose and implement useful improvements, checking whether they save time and improve accuracy.
* Verify AI output against original documents and accounting records. Protect confidential information and follow company rules for approved tools and data use. You remain responsible for accuracy; AI does not replace payment authorisation or accounting judgment.

We will ask for a brief example of an AI\-assisted workflow you have used and how you checked its results. Coding or building AI software is not required.

**What you bring**

* At least five years of relevant bookkeeping or accounting experience, including at least two years independently owning a recurring accounting cycle.
* Strong recent QuickBooks Online experience, including bank and credit\-card reconciliation, accounts payable, correcting errors and month\-end work.
* Evidence of taking ownership: setting priorities, resolving problems, coordinating others and meeting deadlines without repeated reminders.
* Practical AI experience, sound spreadsheet skills and confidence learning new systems.
* Clear written communication and good judgment when handling payments, vendor details and confidential records.
* U.S. residence and the ability to meet the stated weekday availability requirement.

Construction, trades or project\-based accounting experience is strongly preferred. QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification is helpful. Demonstrated capability matters more than a particular degree or previous job title.

**What success looks like**

During your first 90 days, you will establish a dependable weekly accounting routine, own an agreed month\-end close schedule, make outstanding issues visible, and document the core payment and reimbursement workflows. You will also implement an agreed AI\-assisted improvement and demonstrate that its output is reliable.

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your résumé and brief answers to our screening questions. Specific examples of work you personally owned are more useful than broad descriptions of your strengths. Shortlisted applicants will have a focused interview and professional reference checks. No take\-home exercise is required.

Pay: $65,539\.45 \- $83,148\.59 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

new_jobs.description:
**REMOTE Learning Program Manager, International Programs**

The future of learning deserves the right talent. CapeTalent connects AI\-forward Learning \& Development professionals with Fortune 100 companies driving innovation at scale.


**CONTRACT DETAILS**W2 employment is not available for this engagement.
* 1099/C2C Only
* **EST HOURS**
* 6\-month contract (strong likelihood of extension)
* **REMOTE**
* Start date: October 2026
* 40 hours per week @ $55\-$65/hour (C2C or 1099\), based on experience
* Standard U.S. business hours
* Heavy Slack collaboration \+ Laptop provided
* **EST Hours**
* **Portfolio REQUIRED**


**The Opportunity**

As Learning Program Manager, International Programs, you'll design and manage the training programs that prepare our Experts in the UK, Canada, and Australia, and keep them in step with our US programs. When the US training changes, you'll decide what each international program needs, design the solution, and work with our Instructional Designers to bring it to life.


This role blends learning design and program management. You'll use your instructional design skills to shape learning journeys that build real job skills, and your organizational skills to keep many updates moving across three regions. It's a great fit for someone who is organized, detail\-oriented, and enjoys working with a team spread across time zones. If you've designed and managed training, onboarding, or enablement programs and have experience with accounting or bookkeeping software, we'd love to hear from you.


**What You'll Do**

**Keeping Programs Aligned Across Markets**

* Keep an eye on changes to US training and assess how they affect the UK, Canadian, and Australian programs.
* Compare US and international programs to identify content that needs to be updated, adapted for the local market, added, or removed.
* Tell the difference between product changes that apply everywhere and local differences (e.g., tax, payroll, compliance, and terminology) so each program stays accurate for its learners.
* Keep a clear, current view of where each international program stands compared with the US version.

**Designing Learning Programs**

* Conduct needs analyses to define clear, measurable, performance\-based learning outcomes tied to job success.
* Design learning journeys, curricula, and course outlines for international learners, including onboarding, product, and process training.
* Apply instructional design methods (e.g., ADDIE, SAM) and adult learning principles to build engaging, accessible learning with meaningful practice and scenarios.
* Design assessments and knowledge checks that confirm learners are ready for the job.

**Working with Instructional Designers**

* Turn identified gaps into clear, prioritized update requests for the Instructional Design team.
* Give designers the context, source materials, and expectations they need to make changes efficiently.
* Review updated content for accuracy and consistency before it goes live.

**Program Management**

* Manage updates from start to finish: intake, prioritization, scheduling, tracking, review, and launch.
* Juggle timelines and workloads across multiple updates at once using project trackers and checklists.
* Build and improve repeatable processes for keeping international programs in sync with the US.
* Spot bottlenecks early and suggest practical fixes.

**Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as the main point of contact between US and international learning teams.
* Work Eastern Time hours to collaborate in real time with overseas teammates.
* Share progress, risks, and milestones clearly with leadership and partner teams, and raise issues early.

**Measuring Results \& Improving**

* Track program metrics such as content accuracy, learner engagement, completion, and effectiveness across regions.
* Gather and act on feedback from learners and stakeholders in each market.
* Keep program documentation, course materials, and change records up to date in the LMS and related systems.

**Qualifications**

**Must\-Have**

* Experience managing learning or training programs end to end (e.g., Learning Program Manager, Training Manager, L\&D Program Manager, Enablement Manager, or similar).
* Strong instructional design skills: needs analysis, learning objectives, curriculum and course design, and applying adult learning principles.
* Hands\-on experience with accounting or bookkeeping software, whether as a user, trainer, support specialist, bookkeeper, or accountant.
* Located on the US East Coast, or able to consistently work Eastern Time hours to align with our overseas team.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience managing programs or projects that involve several teams or departments.
* Experience with training programs for more than one country or region, or adapting content for different audiences.
* Familiarity with tax, bookkeeping, accounting, or payroll, especially differences between the US, UK, Canada, and Australia.
* Experience leading or partnering with Instructional Designers and eLearning developers.
* Experience with training for customer support, service, or other customer\-facing teams.
* Experience with any LMS or learning platform (e.g., Degreed, Docebo, Credly, Cornerstone, Workday Learning), and authoring tools such as Articulate Rise or Storyline.
* Comfortable with project tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Smartsheet) and Agile or similar ways of working.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and experience working with remote, distributed teams.
* Bachelor's degree required; a Master's in Instructional Design, Education, Business, or a related field is a plus.

new_jobs.description:
WorldClinic, Inc. is redefining healthcare, delivering physician\-led, immediate\-access care that achieves exceptional clinical outcomes and strong financial returns.

  

Through our two platforms, we serve both ends of the workforce: **WorldClinic** provides 24/7 connected healthcare to globally mobile executives and business leaders, resolving the majority of medical issues in a single call. **JobSiteCare** has redefined occupational health for employers with frontline and at\-risk workforces through a combination of telemedicine and on\-site medics, delivering end\-to\-end case management from injury through return\-to\-work – resulting in significant reductions in OSHA recordables and workers’ compensation claim costs.

  

Together, we deliver clinical excellence and measurable outcomes at scale, for any patient population, anywhere.

  

Just as deeply as we care for the patients we serve, we invest in our own team. You'll find a mission\-driven culture that values contribution, encourages growth, and empowers employees to do meaningful work.

  

Offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check (and for Health and Wellness Specialist positions a pre\-employment drug screen). WorldClinic, Inc (and its affiliates) is a drug\-free workplace and complies with all applicable federal and state laws regarding testing. Refusal to submit to a test or failure to meet the requirements of the background check will result in the withdrawal of the employment offer.

 **Business Analyst**

**Location:** Remote (United States) – *Must be available during Eastern Time core hours*

**Job Type:** Full\-time, Exempt

**Department:** Product Management

**About Us:**  

Join WorldClinic and JobSiteCare, physician\-led companies redefining healthcare delivery through immediate\-access care and occupational health innovation. We are a mission\-driven culture that values contribution, encourages growth, and empowers employees to do meaningful work. We're looking for a proactive Business Analyst to sit at the center of our product and technology work, translating how our business operates into clear requirements our development teams can build against.

**About the Role:**

* Serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating clinical, operational, and commercial needs into technical realities.
* Elicit and document clear business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workflow observation, and collaborative working sessions.
* Map current\-state and future\-state processes, identifying gaps, redundancies, and clear automation opportunities.
* Write unambiguous user stories with testable acceptance criteria, partnering with QA and engineering to eliminate guesswork before development begins.
* Maintain and groom the product backlog alongside product managers by writing, refining, and prioritizing work items.
* Support data migration and system integration efforts, including field mapping, data validation rules, reconciliation, and cutover readiness.
* Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT) by building test scenarios, coordinating business testers, and tracking defect resolution to closure.
* Produce and maintain critical supporting documentation, including process maps, data dictionaries, release notes, and end\-user training materials.
* Contribute actively to sprint ceremonies (planning, standup, review, retrospective) to keep delivery status visible and honest.

**Ideal Candidates:**

* **Experienced:** 3\+ years as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or in a comparable requirements\-focused role.
* **Agile\-Savvy:** Demonstrated experience writing user stories and managing backlogs using tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.
* **Analytical:** Strong process mapping skills with fluency in diagramming tools like Lucidchart, Visio, or similar.
* **Communicator:** Exceptional written and verbal skills, with the ability to produce documentation that a busy executive and a software developer will both find highly useful.
* **Organized:** Proven ability to manage competing priorities across multiple concurrent workstreams without dropping threads.
* **Collaborative:** A track record of working effectively in a distributed team with proactive communication and comfort driving alignment over video and text.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in healthcare, digital health, EHR/EMR systems, or regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2\).
* Experience supporting a platform migration, major system implementation, or API\-based integrations.
* Exposure to behavior\-driven development (BDD) and Gherkin\-style (Given/When/Then) acceptance criteria.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent practical experience.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary seated or standing position for up to 8 hours daily while working on a computer.
* Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other digital office equipment to draft requirements and map workflows.
* Must be able to frequently communicate, present, and exchange accurate information over video conferencing platforms and in writing with distributed team members.
* Must be able to have close visual acuity to perform activities such as analyzing data, viewing a computer terminal, and extensive reading or documentation review.

**Perks \& Benefits:**

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* HSA \& FSA
* 401(k) \+ match
* Paid time off \& tuition reimbursement
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible remote work schedule

85,000 \- 110,000 USD per year(Remote)

new_jobs.description:
About Blooma

Blooma is a commercial real estate (CRE) lending and underwriting platform. We help lenders move faster by pulling data out of rent rolls, operating statements, and appraisals so their underwriters can focus on decisions instead of data entry. A big part of that speed comes from our parsing pipeline, a mix of automation and a team of human parsers who make sure the data is right.

The Role

We're hiring a Parsing Operations Team Lead to run the day\-to\-day of our parsing operation. You'll be the point person for our offshore parsing team (managed through our partner Pointing Fish), making sure their work, both document parsing and Blooma platform QA during deployments, is flowing, high quality, and unblocked.

This is a good fit for someone early in their career who's organized, communicative, and comfortable working with a distributed team. You don't need a technical background. You need to be sharp, reliable, and good at keeping things on track.

What You'll Do

* Own day\-to\-day throughput and quality of the offshore parsing team's work, across both document parsing and Blooma platform QA during deployments
* Handle escalations from the parsing team by unblocking questions, clarifying requirements, and looping in Blooma engineering or product when needed
* Coordinate with the US team (product, engineering, customer success) so priorities and blockers stay visible
* Support training and continuous improvement of the parsing team on new document types, tricky edge cases, and evolving requirements
* Lead the parsing team on one\-off projects the company sends their way
* Pitch in on product operations side projects as they come up. Good exposure if you want to grow into product or ops

What We're Looking For

* Strong written and verbal communication. You'll spend a lot of your day in Slack, email, and video calls with people in different time zones
* Organized and self\-directed. This role has real independence and we need someone who can prioritize their own day
* Comfortable working with an international team. Cultural awareness, patience, and clear communication matter
* Detail\-oriented. A lot of the value here is catching the small things that are off
* Bias toward figuring things out. You'll learn our platform, our documents, and our workflows on the job

We don't require a specific degree or background. Recent grads and career\-changers are welcome to apply.

Nice to Have

* Previous experience in operations, data analysis, QA, or offshore team coordination
* Familiarity with Jira, Slack, or AI tools like Claude
* Any exposure to commercial real estate, lending, or finance

What You Get

* Full\-time W\-2, fully remote (US only)
* Real exposure to AI tools, product ops, CRE, and international team management. A solid launchpad if you want to grow into product, ops, or analyst work

How to Apply

To be considered, please complete our application at https://bit.ly/4hPBkIG. Applications submitted through Indeed alone will not be reviewed.

* Dental insurance

* Paid time off
